original: Rambling Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
My dearest Folokia,

How I wish to hold you and your lushious red hair in my masculine arms once more. Sorry, I meant to write 'strawberry blonde' but alas my quill hastens under the threat of iminent death. Though you slapped me the last time we met with a strength of arm akin to a bear, my love for you remains as strong as the day I first laid eyes upon you.

The jailors here refuse to speak to me, but I cannot imagine why. The quality of my company, as you know, is second to none. I have been incarcerated in this dreary hell hole for time immemorable with no creature comforts to speak of. Alas it pains me to have to shit in a bucket every day like a wild animal, but at least I'm still going on a regular basis.

These rag-tag degenerate wizards, a pox on them I say. Locking me away here without so much as a decent conversation to wile away the hours. I have laid down my lute for now and have taken to the quill. Perhaps I missed my true calling? As the days go by, my resolve weakens and I fear the only thing keeping me sane are my poignant words. Poignant is the right word to use in this situation, is it not? I cannot say, the monkeys that traverse this pit are all but illiterate, I fear.

Regardless, allow me to bestow upon to you the fruit of my endeavors. A poem stirring enough to rouse even a frosted heart. Brace yourself, my love.

There once was an orc named Glorburk,
Whom was inexorably berserk,
He was fat and smelly,
Had a big belly,
And the kitchens are where he would lurk.

Perhaps the blue bird's tweet will carry these words on the wind. The rest is up to the whims of destiny.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
我心爱的弗洛基娅，

我多么希望能再一次将你和你那浓密火红的秀发拥入我强健的臂弯。抱歉，我本想写“草莓金发”的，但在死亡临近之时我不得不写得快一些。虽然我们上次见面时，你用堪比熊的力量甩了我一巴掌，但我对你的爱意却依旧如初见那天般炽热。

这儿的狱卒不愿意跟我说话，我也不知道为什么。你也知道，我的伙伴是无与伦比的。我已经在这片沉闷得无法形容的地狱里被关了不知多久，连一点基本的舒适都谈不上。哎，每天像野兽一样对着桶拉屎确实让我难受，但至少我还保持规律。

这些乌合之众般的堕落法师们，愿瘟疫降临在他们身上！把我关在这里，连个能聊上几句的人都没有，打发时间都难。我现在已经放下了鲁特琴，拿起了羽毛笔。也许我真正的天命其实是当个诗人？日子一天天过去，我的意志逐渐消沉，恐怕唯一还能让我保持理智的，就是我那些感人至深的文字了。在这种情况下，“感人”这个词用得合适吧？我也不敢确定，毕竟这里来来往往的猴子们几乎都不识字，真让人担心。

不过无论如何，请允许我献上我的努力成果。这是一首足以唤醒冰封之心的动人诗篇。准备好吧，我的爱人：

曾有位兽人名为葛洛布库，
无人能阻挡他的脚步，
他浑身上下臭呼呼，
肚子胖的胀鼓鼓，
只有厨房能让他来潜伏。

愿蓝色小鸟衔着这条信息随风传递给你。剩下的，就交给命运的摆布了。
</font>

original: Bandit Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Don't know how long that old fart has been down here, he certainly looks like an odd fellow but I'm not one to hold it against him. Said he's been studying the draugr, using them to develop some fancy spell that allows him to control their movements. Sounds like a power that could come in handy in our next raid. But what really got my attention was when he said that he might be able to modify the spell to control anything, not just the dust walkers but living people too! A power like that ... I can't even begin to fathom what we could accomplish! What ... "I" could accomplish. If what he says is true, then I can't let him leave until I get my hands on that spell. So we struck a deal, we don't send in more of our buddies to harass him and in return he transcribes that spell for us when he's done.

I've taken that old nordic sword we found deeper down, it seems to open and close the gate at front entrance so I need to make sure I don't mix it up with the others. While the sword itself seems fearsome enough with its ability to resurrect anything it cuts, it pales in comparison to the spell the wizard is working on. I just hope he finishes before I end up looking like he does. We're gathering the loot at the old shipwreck along the coast near the mining settlement. Once we've cleared the place out, we'll meet at the docks and have it transported to Skyrim. Hopefully this contraband is still worth something if we can't find what the boss is looking for.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
那老头在这儿待了多久我也不清楚，他看起来确实挺古怪的，不过我倒不至于因此对他有偏见。他说他一直在研究尸鬼，用它们做研究材料开发出了一个复杂的法术，能让他控制它们的行动。听起来这种能力在我们下一次突袭中会非常有用。但真正引起我注意的是，他说他或许还能改良这个法术，让它不仅能控制那些“行尸走肉”，甚至连活人也能操控！这样一种力量……我简直无法想象我们能办到多少事！不，是我能办到多少事！如果他说的是真的，那在他离开之前，我绝不能让他从我手中溜走。于是我们达成了交易：我们不再去打扰他，作为交换，等他完成法术后，他会把它抄写下来交给我们。

我把我们在更深处找到的那把古老的诺德剑拿走了，它似乎能控制入口处的闸门开合，所以我得小心别和其他剑搞混了。虽然这把剑本身就很可怕——它能复活被它砍中的任何东西——但和那个法师正在研究的法术相比，就逊色多了。我只希望他能在我变成他那样之前赶紧完成。我们正在矿区定居点附近海岸边的一艘旧沉船上收集战利品。等我们清理完那里之后，就去码头集合，把这些东西运回天际。如果我们找不到头目想要的东西，希望这些违禁品还能卖个好价钱。
</font>

original: Tattered Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Time loses all meaning when stuck in an abyss without day or night to serve as guidance. I wonder how long it has been since I fell down that damned shaft. With all this dwemer scrap I could've forged a ladder by now, but with my deteriorating health I suppose it matters little anymore. Perhaps the damp air down here is also slowly rotting my mind?

Darkness seeps into my eyes as my vision begins to fail me, still I must remain at constant vigil. While there are enough fish down here to sustain me for the time being, I fear I may meet my demise to one of those pointy-eared demons; those 'falmer' as Brunjar once described to me, but what ever happened to him since he left I haven't the slightest. He fell down the trap and landed here with me, but like other hot-blooded nords that pass through every so often he likely died trying to sneak past the falmer in search of a way out of this deceptively beautiful world. They have those big ears for a reason I kept telling him, of course they'd hear you what with those steel boots of yours! The fool. Never found his remains either. I suppose at first I was no different, I too once longed for freedom, although the one thing that separated me from Brunjar is that I made it back here alive!

One thing I know about this place is that the traps still function perfectly. For now, they help me fend off small groups of falmer that skulk around nearby every so often. Lately they seem to be more agitated than usual. Their antics may be comical at times but I must remember never to underestimate their cunning. Still, their numbers dwindle day by day and while the cause remains obscured to me I'd best keep to the ruins for now for the sake of my own safety.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
在这没有昼夜更替的深渊中，时间早已失去了意义。我已经记不清自己掉进这个该死的竖井有多久了。有周围这些了矮人废铁，我本可以打造出一架梯子逃出去的，但以我现在每况愈下的身体状况来看，这些似乎也无关紧要了。也许这潮湿的空气正在慢慢腐蚀我的头脑？

黑暗渗入我的双眼，我的视力正在衰退，但我仍必须时刻保持警惕。虽然这里的鱼足够我暂时维持生命，但我担心最终会被那些尖耳朵的恶魔所杀害，布伦贾称它们为“伐莫”。但他后来怎么样了？自从他离开之后，我就再也没见过他。他和我一样也掉进了陷阱，落到了这个地方，不过像其他偶尔路过的热血诺德人一样，他大概已经在试图偷偷绕过伐莫寻找出口时丢了性命。我早就告诉他，他们那对大耳朵可不是白长的！你穿着那双叮当作响的钢靴走路，他们怎么可能听不到！真是个蠢货。我至今也没找到他的遗体。起初我和他也没什么不同，也曾渴望自由。但与他唯一不同的是，我活了下来，回到了这里！

我对这个地方唯一确信的一点是：这里的陷阱依旧运作良好。目前它们还能帮我击退偶尔靠近的小股伐莫。最近它们看起来比平时更加焦躁不安了。虽然它们的行为有时令人发笑，但我绝不能低估它们的狡诈。尽管如此，它们的数量正在一天天减少，虽然我还搞不清楚原因，但为了安全起见，我最好还是继续待在这里。
</font>

original: Alberthor's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Of course I wasn't being serious when I told that group of bandits I'd transcribe a spell for them, I just said that so they'd leave me and my work alone. I should've flambed them when I had the chance. Well, maybe I'll reconsider the decision once I properly attune my spell and have no need of further test subjects. For now I suppose I can tolerate their presence, but once I'm done I'm blasting them all to Oblivion -- literally if I can get that planar transfiguration spell working. My genius knows no bounds ... occasionally.

While on the topic, the latest test subject involved in the mind-control experiment suffered from what I suspect was a rather unfortunate miscalculation on my behalf. I don't know exactly what happened to him but I suspect I accidentally transferred the draugr's mind into *his* rather than vice versa. He began frothing at the mouth shortly after I performed the transfer but most remarkably, despite having bound him with a simple paralysis spell, he managed to break free. Luckily for me his movements seemed limited to walking repeatedly against the wall seemingly oblivious to it.

But on more pressing matters, I suspect the Thalmor have somehow caught wind of my presence. How they discovered my location escapes me entirely. Divination perhaps? I can't think of anyone skilled enough in their ranks. Certainly the bandits here just think I'm just a crazy old wizard not that I would deny such a claim. Perhaps it is now a more accurate summation than a past persona I once clung to. Regardless, to turn the situation to my favor and to test the latest advancements of my mind control spell, I sent a group of draugr out to his encampment within the glaciers. The look on his face ... marvelous how fear contorts one's facial physique. Luckily there's no shortage of draugr here, whomever this temple was constructed for was likely a notable figure in nordic history, however I haven't the time to concern myself with such trivialities.

Despite my best efforts to hide the claw key to the puzzle door in the crypts in order to prevent more louts from falling down that shaft, it would seem that it was recently stolen again. I suppose I should stop hiding it in the pantry and choose a more suitable location. A pocket plane perhaps? More food for the falmer, I suppose. But I digress, I do suspect something is afoot. Why the sudden surge of misfits and adventurers? Some sort of uprising maybe? Certainly the Empire isn't one to shy away from grave robbing expeditions, but who am I to frown upon such endeavors? I suppose the bandits did me a favor by closing the gate at the entrance, maybe now I'll be able to enjoy some peace and quiet again though at this rate I find it highly unlikely such solitude will last for very long.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
当然，我对那群强盗说要给他们抄写法术时并不是认真的，我只是想让他们别来打扰我和我的研究罢了。我真该在有机会的时候就一把火把他们烧成灰。嗯，也许等我把这个法术彻底完善、不再需要更多的实验对象后，我会重新考虑这个决定。现在嘛，我勉强可以忍受他们的存在，但等我完成一切之后，我会亲手把他们全都轰进湮灭——如果我能成功施展那个位面转换法术的话，我的天才真是无止境……虽然只是偶尔如此。

说到实验，最近一个参与心智控制实验的测试对象似乎遭遇了某种不幸的失误……恐怕是我的计算出了差错。我不太清楚他到底发生了什么，但我怀疑我可能不小心把尸鬼的意识转移到了他身上，而不是反过来。转移完成后不久，他就口吐白沫了，而最令人惊讶的是，尽管他被一个简单的麻痹咒束缚住了，他还是设法挣脱了。幸运的是，他的行动能力似乎仅限于不断一头撞向墙壁，而且看起来完全没有意识到自己在做什么。

不过更紧迫的事情是，我怀疑梭默已经察觉到了我的存在。关于他们究竟是怎么找到这里的，我是完全摸不着头脑。难道是用了占卜？我不认为他们之中有人精通这种东西。当然，这里的强盗大概只觉得我是个疯老头——我也不会否认这一点。比起过去那个我曾坚持扮演的角色形象，它恐怕还更准确一些。无论如何，为了扭转局势并测试我心智控制法术的最新进展，我派出了一队尸鬼前往他们在冰川中的营地。看到他脸上那种恐惧的表情……真是美妙极了，恐惧是如何扭曲一个人面部表情的啊！幸运的是这里从来不缺尸鬼，这座神殿的建造者在诺德历史上想必也是个举足轻重的人物，但我实在没空去关心这些琐事。

尽管我已经尽力将通往密室的机关龙爪藏在了一个隐秘的地方，以防止更多莽撞的家伙掉进那个竖井里，但它最近又被偷了。我想我该换个地方藏了，不能再放在食品储藏室里了。也许我可以藏进一个口袋空间？恐怕那也只会给那些伐莫提供更多食物。好吧回到正题，我确实觉得事情有些不对劲。为什么最近突然冒出来这么多怪人和冒险者？难道某种潮流？帝国确实不介意有人来挖坟掘墓，但我又有什么资格对此皱眉呢？也许强盗们帮我关上了入口的闸门倒是一件好事，说不定我又能安静一阵子了——不过照目前的情况来看，这种宁静恐怕持续不了多久。
</font>

original: Marauder's Plans

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
Sure, our hideout in Coldwave Crescent is about as hidden as any hideout could be, but getting goods up there is proving to be just too difficult. Keeping everything dockside is not only easier, but gives us an avenue of escape should someone come after us.

I think we've gotten everything of value from the hideout, but I can't shake the feeling that there's something I've forgotten...
</font>
string:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
当然，我们在寒波湾畔的藏身处几乎是所有藏身处中最隐蔽的，但要把货物运到那里实在是太困难了。把所有东西都放在码头上不仅更容易，而且如果有人来追杀我们，这还能给我们提供一条出路。

我想我们已经把藏身处所有值钱的东西都拿走了，但我总觉得好像忘了什么东西……
</font>

original: Starving Marauder's Note

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
It has been more than a tenday since the boys last returned and I am beginning to fear that something may have happened to them. We thought this to be the ideal hiding spot; far from the road and hidden from the warlocks and vampires. But without a way down it is little more than a tomb now. I have eaten through the last of our supplies. If they don't return soon... well, I may have to risk a few broken bones.
</font>

original: Wyrmstone: Red and Blue

[pagebreak]

Wyrmstone: Red and Blue Report by Lurius Liore

[pagebreak]

Wyrmstooth's value to the empire in terms of its natural resources is certainly undeniable, though perhaps at times unappreciated. While ebony may be a scarce commodity on the island, Wyrmstooth is host to a unique ore rarely seen elsewhere on mainland Tamriel which has hence earned the name 'Wyrmstone'. The bluish ore is distributed fairly ubiquitously across the island and trace amounts seem to permeate practically all rock. As to the nature of the ore itself, studies indicate structural properties similar to those seen in malachite and other naturally occurring glass. Some scholars indicate that it is in fact a form of malachite exposed to unusual geological conditions however this is still subject to further inquiry. Recent analysis from the College of Winterhold indicates that each fragment of the material holds a very subtle magical charge. Blacksmiths however report the fragile nature of the ore as being very difficult or impractical to work with. Of course this does not mean that it is impossible and the practical implementation of the material may not necessarily be limited to the crafting of weapons and armor. On my most recent voyage to the imperial city I was granted a brief opportunity to speak with the moth priests and questioned them about the unusual nature of the ore. Some claim the dwemer knew of a way to refine it into a material they call aetherium though this seems to be a matter of contention as the dwemer were said to have refined aetherium from meteoric glass, not volcanic glass. Regardless, the magical nature of the ore draws a number of mages to the island on an annual basis. What they do with the ore they dig up and the quantity they remove from the island is beyond the interest of the East Empire Company given its current lack of mainstream value, however some enchanters are known to use the material in the creation of staffs. A rare variant of Wyrmstone is sporadically encountered following recent seismic activity. Brimstone, reddish in color, has proven to be even more brittle than standard Wyrmstone. Given time, Brimstone eventually transforms to the common blue Wyrmstone as seen elsewhere around the island. The cause behind this transformation is likely chemical in nature, perhaps a reaction caused by extended exposure to the atmosphere or a reaction with sunlight? Future analysis will determine the structural differences between the two ores once a sample becomes available.
string:
[pagebreak]

龙石：红与蓝 卢里乌斯·里奥尔 报告

[pagebreak]

从自然资源的角度来看，龙牙岛对帝国的价值无疑是巨大的，尽管这种价值有时可能并未得到应有的重视。虽然黑檀在岛上是一种稀缺资源，但龙牙岛却蕴藏着一种独特的矿石——这种矿石在泰姆瑞尔大陆的其他地方极为罕见，因此得名“龙石”。 这种呈蓝色的矿石广泛分布于全岛各地，几乎在所有岩石中都能检测到微量的存在。关于这种矿石本身的性质，研究表明其结构特性与孔雀石和一些天然玻璃有着相似之处。一些学者认为，它实际上是经历了特殊地质条件作用后的孔雀石变种，但这一观点仍有待进一步研究确认。 来自冬堡学院的最新分析表明，这种矿石的每一块碎片内部都蕴含着一种极其微弱的魔法能量。然而铁匠们则指出，这种矿石非常脆弱，极难加工，甚至根本不具备上手操作的可行性。当然，这并不意味着对其进行加工利用是绝对不可能的，它的实际应用领域或许并不仅限于武器与护甲的锻造。 在我最近一次前往帝都的旅途中，我有幸短暂地与蛾祭司交谈，并向他们请教了关于这种矿石种种奇特性质的问题。有传闻称，古老的锻莫曾掌握着一种特殊的技艺，能够将这种矿石提炼转化为一种被称为神光水晶的物质，不过这点尚存争议，因为据史料记载，锻莫是从陨石玻璃而非火山玻璃中提炼出神光水晶的。无论如何，这种矿石所蕴含的魔法属性每年都会吸引大量法师前来岛屿。至于他们将这些挖走的矿石用于何处、带走的数量有多少，东帝国公司目前并不关心，毕竟它尚未具备主流商业价值。不过，据我们所知，确实有一些附魔师会用它来制作法杖。 在近期的地震活动后，人们偶尔会发现一种稀有的龙石变种——这种变种呈红褐色，被称为硫磺石。它比普通的龙石更加脆弱。但随着时间推移，这种硫磺石最终会转化为岛上常见的蓝色龙石。这种转变很可能是化学反应引起的，或许是由于长期暴露在空气中，又或许是在阳光照射下引发反应所致？一旦获得样本，未来的分析工作将有助于确定这两种矿石在结构上的差异。

original: Bloodstained Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Today I once again find myself in an unprofitable situation. Unprofitable both for myself and for my guild whom of which, I can only assume, have begun their obligatory manhunt for my whereabouts. I estimate days have passed since I fell down that shaft in the nordic ruins and the return on investment so far has been insubstantial; the market value of falmer equipment is next to worthless. 

I lost consciousness while scouting the caverns looking for a way out. I suspect I was ambushed by a falmer hunting party, though I find their organizational skills to be questionable to say the least. The falmer appear to be gathering corpses into a chamber deeper down, I can only speculate as to why so many corpses are required -- certainly not for appetite reduction management.

Perhaps they serve the whims of a more powerful entity situated further on through the ruins? I'd investigate the situation myself, but with these crude low-value weapons inserted haphazardly into my anatomy with minimal tactical discretion, and with my strength diminishing exponentially, I fear I have not long to live. Dying is such a grossly inefficient use of time.

If you find my corpse, sell my remains. I would've done the same thing for you.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
今天，我又一次陷入了毫无收益的境地。不仅对我自己来说毫无收获，对我的公会而言恐怕也是一场失败的投资——我只能假设他们已经开始按惯例派出人手追查我的下落。算起来，我已经掉进这座诺德遗迹深处好几天了，而截至目前的回报几乎为零——因为伐莫装备在市场上几乎一文不值。

我在探索洞穴、寻找出口时失去了意识。我估计自己是遭遇了一支伐莫狩猎小队的伏击，虽然说实在的，他们的组织能力实在令人质疑。我发现这些伐莫正将大量尸体搬运到更深处的一个房间里，至于为何需要这么多尸体，我只能猜测……肯定不是为了食物储备。

也许他们在为遗迹更深处某个更为强大的存在服务？我自己本想去探个究竟，但此刻我身上正胡乱插着几件粗制滥造、毫无价值的武器，对方下手毫无战术可言，而我的体力也在以指数级的速度迅速流失。恐怕我命不久矣。死，真是对时间最浪费不过的挥霍。

如果你找到了我的尸体，就把我的遗物都卖了换点钱吧。换了我，也会这么对你做的。
</font>

original: Lurius' Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
How many times do I need to make myself clear; do NOT, under any circumstance, enter the ruins without my express permission! Anyone caught smuggling dwarven artifacts out of the recently uncovered ruins will have their wages docked! Honestly I don't think I'm getting through to anyone.

The trouble started a few weeks ago when I heard word that the miners had broken through to some old underground ruins. I wasn't terribly surprised given what we know about the island, but one of the miners mentioned something about an enormous subterranean cavity deep below that his ancestors referred to as Dimfrost. What was the miner's name? Gunthur? Or was it Gundur? I'm terrible with those guttural nordic names. I'd gather the guards and investigate the situation myself if I wasn't so busy dealing with the thieves and smugglers inside the mines. Not to mention the marauders outside. Or the frost trolls. Or the giants.

At this rate the settlement will be in flames in no time...
</font>

麻烦始于几周以前，我听说有些矿工打通了一处古老的地下遗迹。鉴于我们对这座岛已有的了解，我倒也没太吃惊。直到我听一个矿工说这儿的地下深处有个巨大的空洞，他说他的先辈们将它称为暗霜。那个矿工叫什么名字来着？纲泽尔？还是纲达尔？我真是受够这些绕口的诺德名字了。如果我不是正忙着对付矿里头的盗贼和走私犯——还有外面的掠夺者、霜巨魔，以及巨人——我早就亲自带上卫兵去调查了。

照这个情况发展下去，用不了多久，整个定居点都得陷入一片火海了……

original: Miner's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
A few weeks ago we broke into some sort of underground chamber; old dwarven ruins by the looks of it. Pa used to tell me stories about how the dwarves suddenly vanished long ago for reasons that, to this day, remain unknown. Certainly there weren't any left behind down there from what I could see when I went poking around, but Lurius says to stay away because it's dangerious. That place gives me the shivers and not just because it's gods-forsakenly cold. One of our boys, Gundur, had mentioned that the ruins lead even further down into a vast underground chasm that his ancestors used to call Dimfrost. Says he also saw movement down there, like people scurrying about, but couldn't make out any specific details. I plan on taking a look tomorrow, if I can get away from prying eyes that is.

Expansion of the mine has halted for now while Lurius decides whether we should seal away the ruins. Well, what's left of it that is. I swear half the miners here made more money pilfering artifacts over the past few days than they have mining orichalcum for the past year. I, for one, prefer earning my coin the honest way. Well, for now at least.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
几周前，我们无意中打通了一个地下大厅，看起来像是古老的锻莫遗迹。老爸以前常给我讲那些矮人很久以前突然消失的故事，直到今天，他们的去向依然是个谜。就我所见，当我四处探查的时候，那里一个活人都没留下，不过卢里乌斯说那地方很危险，让我们离远点。那个地方让我浑身发毛，也不光是因为冷得要命。我们这边有个小伙子叫纲达尔，他说这些遗迹甚至还能通向更深的地底，进入一个他的祖先称之为“暗霜”的巨大地下空洞。他还说在下面看到了动静，像是有人在到处跑动，但看不清具体是什么情况。我打算明天去看看——当然，要是能避开那些多管闲事的眼睛的话。

目前矿井的扩建已经暂停了，卢里乌斯正在决定是否应该把遗迹重新封起来。呃，或者说……把剩下的东西封起来。我发誓，这里一半的矿工在过去几天里靠倒卖文物赚的钱，比他们过去挖整一年山铜矿赚得还多。而我嘛，至少现在还是更喜欢用诚实的方式挣我的铜板。
</font>

original: Dusty Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Construction is underway on a new fort closer to the docks and the mining settlement. Of course that makes us pretty much obsolete now. Catius says we'll be reassigned soon and perhaps it's for the best.

The stories he's told about the history of this fort have had me on edge ever since I arrived. Stories about witches that once lived here during the time the fort went unmanned. Silly stories when you come to think about it, but sometimes I hear ... whispers echoing through the cracks in the stone. Likely just the smiths work at the forge, but I can't help but wonder whether there's any truth to it. After-all, Valus was built on top of an old nordic ruin. Even now as I write I feel a pair of hungry eyes upon me.

Angvar is late as usual. He was supposed to deliver the supplies to Thaydar a week ago. If he's late again he might be reassigned to cleaning duty. Gunnor's bowels reacted explosively to the chef's cuisine last night so that aught to give him extra incentive to deliver those supplies on time for a change. I also hear there's another outbreak of rockjoint at the mining settlement again. I feel sorry for those poor sods. Mining those mountains has got to be one of the worst jobs imaginable.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
新堡垒的建设已经在靠近码头和矿区定居点的地方开始了。当然，这让我们变得几乎毫无用处了。卡提乌斯说我们就要调离这儿了，如果真是那样真是太好了。

他在我抵达这里的时候给我讲过这座要塞的历史，直到现在我回想起来还有些毛骨悚然。那是在堡垒无人驻守的时期，曾经居住在这里的女巫们的故事。若要仔细推敲，会发现故事到处都是漏洞，但有些时候我总觉得……我真的有听到从岩石缝隙中飘来的低语。虽然这声音或许是铁匠摆弄锻炉时所发出的回音，但我还是忍不住会去想这些传言是否有些真实成分。毕竟，瓦鲁斯可是建造在一座古诺德遗迹的顶端。就在我写这些字的时候，都觉得有什么饥肠辘辘的东西在盯着我。

安戈瓦又像平时一样迟到了，他本来应该一周前就把补给交给塔达尔的，如果他再迟到一次，恐怕就要被调去干清洁工作了。昨晚贡诺尔的肠胃对厨师的手艺产生了剧烈反应——爆炸性的那种——希望这次能让他长点记性，别再迟到了。我还听说矿区定居点又一次爆发了关节石化病，真是替那些可怜虫感到难过。在那山里挖矿，恐怕是这世上最糟糕的工作之一了。
</font>

original: Bazrob's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
If you were to say that I was destined to become the king of nipples, I would not deny it. I would celebrate it. I would rejoice in the very thought of it. I would bathe in its glory and feast mightily upon the very idea that such a destiny could be mine for the taking.

To assume the throne of nipples is my undeniable destiny. I feel it. I feel it in my nipples ... nipples hardened by last winter's snow. Nipples hardened and tempered such that I could strike fear into the hearts of man and beast alike. Yes, I have fashioned my nipples into daggers, sturdy like the tusks of a horker or the teeth of a mountain bear.

I take great pride in the potency of my nipples. The world is cold, people are cold ... I must also harden my heart as I have hardened my nipples.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
如果你说我命中注定要成为乳头之王，我不会否认。我会为此而庆祝。我为此而欣喜。我会沉浸在它的荣耀之中，尽情享受这命运唾手可得的喜悦。

坐上乳头之王的宝座是我不可否认的命运。我感受到了。我在我的乳头里感受到了……那些被去年冬天的雪冻硬的乳头。这些乳头变得如此坚硬和温润，以至于我能够让人类和野兽都心生恐惧。是的，我把我的乳头塑造成了匕首，像海象的獠牙或山熊的牙齿一样坚固。

我为我乳头的威力感到无比自豪。世界是冷酷的，人是冷酷的……我也必须像我硬化我的乳头一样，硬化我的心。
</font>

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">I know we were told to stay away from that ruin, but I can't sit idly by while that damned mage does who knows what to Arnbor. string:

original: Tobus' Note

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
While I had given up the adventuring life quite some time ago, I came to this cold gods-forsaken place after hearing word of treasures beyond imagining. Where I heard such rumors matters not, and while the loot I have gathered is a far cry from 'treasure', I fear the burden I placed on poor Lydia may prove my undoing. If only I had taken the time to sell some of this useless junk I might have been able to move about more freely.

Burdened by the weight of this trash and by my unwillingness to simply leave it behind, I am resigned to my fate and lay here to await the Draugr. I can see the glow of their eyes descending the mountains. They smell my blood. There will be redness before darkness and the whiteness that follows.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
虽然我在很久以前就已经告别了冒险生涯，但在听说了这片寒冷而被神遗弃的地方藏有难以想象的宝藏之后，还是来到了这里。至于这些传言我是从哪里听来的，已经不重要了。虽说我搜罗来的这些战利品远谈不上是什么“宝藏”，但恐怕，我强加在可怜的莱迪亚身上的这份重担，终将成为导致我败亡的祸根。要是我当时肯花点时间把这些没用的破烂卖掉，也许现在我就能更自如地行动了。

背负着这些垃圾的重担，又舍不得干脆将它们丢下，我只能认命，躺在这儿，等待那些尸鬼的到来。我已经能看见他们眼中闪烁的光芒，正顺着山峦缓缓逼近。他们已经闻到了我血液的气味。在黑暗降临之前会有一场血战，随后而至的，将是纯白。
</font>

original: History of Wyrmstooth

[pagebreak]

History of Wyrmstooth by Casius Topellis

[pagebreak]

Situated north of Skyrim in the Sea of Ghosts lies the little-known island of Wyrmstooth. Its jagged crags serve both as a landmark and as a warning to seafarers. I have spent the past few months traversing the island to better learn its history and culture and have compiled my findings in this book. Ancient Nords It's clear the island was once home to a thriving Nord population, based on the many unoccupied ruins scattered across the island. However, unlike the nords of Solstheim, it would seem their society could not survive the fall of the dragon cult. What happened to the nords that once made the island their home is open to speculation, but it would seem most fled to the mainland in the chaos that ensued or resorted to piratery to survive, based on the lack of nordic structures built after this period in time. [pagebreak] East Empire Company While the Empire has tried to establish settlements on the island in the past, most have eventually fallen to ruin. The ruins of Krakevisa and Belonir's Borg are two remnants of such attempts. Only the East Empire Company has managed to establish a long-term presence on the island starting from 3E 433 shortly before the Oblivion crisis. Mining the rich natural resources found on the island serves as the primary reason people risk the dangerous voyage to get here. But while this island may be rich in rare ores, ebony is scarce in quantity and as such the island never garnered the same attention from the Empire that the mining settlement of Raven Rock on Solstheim enjoyed. Due to waning interest, Fort Moonwatch now serves as the Empire's primary garrison on the island. Fort Valus was originally constructed to guard the south-western shipping lane from pirates but has since fallen into disrepair. In recent years, marauders have become a real threat to mining operations and threaten to push the East Empire Company off the island entirely if left unchecked. [pagebreak] Curious Flora The cataclysm of Red Mountain during 4E 5 saw a phenomenal disaster sweep across the Sea of Ghosts. Wyrmstooth was spared much of the carnage as the glaciers along the eastern coast shielded much of the island from destruction. The ashen fallout that followed, however, seeded the island with flora carried all the way from Morrowind. The large Emperor Parasol mushrooms that once covered much of Vvardenfell have taken root on the more temperate western flank of Wyrmstooth and continue to grow there to this day. [pagebreak] Wyrmstooth Barrow The most notable structure stands prominently on the south-eastern corner of the island and is part of an ancient expansive nordic barrow. Its traditional name, according texts left by the ancient nords that once dwelled within the complex, is Duaanjunaar. Dedicated to the dragon cult of old, cultists once performed ceremonies and ritual sacrifices deep within its stone chambers to honor and empower their dragon overlords. Lately the barrow seems to have garnered some reputation among adventuring circles and is treated as a rite of passage. Tamriel is home to many such dangerous crypts and ruins and Wyrmstooth Barrow stands amongst them as exemplary. Those that survive the barrow and its dangers are held in high regard. As a direct result of this dungeon delving, deeper chambers are made more accessible which has had the unfortunate side-effect of aiding looters who make a habit of stealing priceless artifacts entombed within. One can only speculate as to how much history has been lost to greed over the centuries. [pagebreak] Dimfrost Some locals refer to an expansive cavernous structure deep below the island. Given the volcanic nature of this island, the presence of an ancient magma chamber is most certainly plausible. While documented entrances into Dimfrost are rare, any such entrances from the surface are likely to disappear within years of their discovery simply due to the geological instability that also hinders mining operations. Still, some adventurers are gifted with the opportunity to explore this seldom-seen world beneath the surface and tell tales of ethereal beauty and crystaline lakes within a cavern as deep as the sky is high. Pale-skinned folk of elvish appearance and barbaric demeanor have also been reported emerging from dwemer ruins that dot the island. Whether there is substance to these claims is yet to be seen, though future expeditions may yet yield further opportunities to study these ancient ruins with more academic vigor. Certainly a significant dwemer presence here would confound much of what we have come to know about the distribution of that society across Tamriel. [pagebreak] Final Resting Place Finally, it is important to mention the resting place of Vulom, a wizard of ill-repute most infamously known for his successful transformation to Lich-dom using secret techniques derived from the sload - an act and an alliance severely frowned upon by the Mage's guild at the time as were many other necromantic rituals and practices. Vulom, who's name in life was said to be Raydn Malon, took his alias from the language of the dragon priests of old. The word Vulom itself is said to refer to darkness or shadows, apt given the type of magic the wizard dealt in. After several failed attempts by guild wizards, it is said that the Psijic order intervened directly, defeating the lich in open magical combat. As necromancers of such repute are rarely so readily dispatched, his remains were split up and scattered across the island so as to prevent a possible resurrection. Few details remain about his personal life or what ties he was rumoured to have had with the famed necromancer Mannimarco. What remains of his tomb and former lair can be found on the south-western flank of the island close to the shore should one dare to trespass for scholarly purposes.
string:
[pagebreak]

龙牙岛简史 卡西乌斯·托佩里斯 著

[pagebreak]

龙牙岛是一座鲜为人知的岛屿，坐落于天际以北的幽灵海之中。它那锯齿状的峭壁既是航海者的航标，也是对他们的警示。过去的几个月里，我在这座岛上四处游历，只为更深入了解它的历史与文化，并将所见所闻汇编成此书。 古诺德人 从遍布全岛的众多废弃遗迹可以看出，这座岛屿曾是诺德人的繁荣家园。然而，不同于索瑟海姆上的诺德人，他们的社会似乎未能在拜龙教团衰败之后幸存下来。至于那些曾经居住于此的诺德人后来去了哪里，众说纷纭。但根据这一时期之后再未出现新的诺德建筑来看，大多数人可能是在混乱中逃往了大陆，或转而成为海盗以求生存。 [pagebreak] 东帝国贸易公司 虽然帝国过去也曾试图在岛上建立定居点，但绝大多数最终都化为了废墟。如今的克瑞克维萨和贝隆尼的堡垒便是这些失败尝试留下的遗迹。真正能在岛上长期驻扎下来的，只有东帝国公司。自第三纪元433年左右，即湮灭危机前夕起，他们便开始在此活动。人们之所以冒着危险来到这里，主要是为了开采岛上丰富的自然资源。尽管岛上蕴藏着多种稀有矿石，但黑檀的储量却极为有限，因此它从未像索瑟海姆上的鸦石镇矿区那样引起帝国的重视。 随着帝国对此岛的兴趣日渐消退，如今观月堡成了帝国在该岛的主要据点。瓦鲁斯堡最初是为了保护西南航道免受海盗侵袭而建，但现已年久失修、荒废不堪。近年来，岛上的掠夺者已成为采矿作业的重大威胁，若不加以遏制，东帝国公司恐将面临被彻底逐出岛屿的厄运。 [pagebreak] 奇异植被 在第四纪元5年期间，红山爆发掀起了一场席卷幽灵海的巨大灾难。幸运的是，龙牙岛东部海岸的冰川挡住了大部分破坏。然而随之而来的灰烬飘落，却将来自晨风的植物种子带到了岛上。曾经覆盖瓦登费尔大片地区的巨型帝王伞，如今已在气候较温和的西部山坡扎根，并持续生长至今。 [pagebreak] 龙牙古坟 岛上最著名的建筑坐落于岛屿东南角，是庞大的古代诺德古墓群的一部分。根据曾居住于此的诺德人留下的文献记载，其原名为杜安约纳尔。这座墓穴曾专门供奉古老的拜龙教团，信徒们在其中幽深的石室中举行仪式和献祭，以供奉并强化他们的龙主。 最近，这座古墓在冒险者圈子里名声渐起，被视为一种试炼之地。泰姆瑞尔大陆上虽然遍布着许多类似的危险墓穴与遗迹，但龙牙古坟无疑名列前茅。凡能从中生还者皆被视作英雄。由于这种地下城探险热潮，古墓深处的房间也逐渐被发掘，但这带来了不幸的副作用，因为这会帮助那些掠夺者，让他们趁机偷走埋藏其中的无价之宝。 可以想见，在这数百年间，又有多少历史因贪婪而永远失落。 [pagebreak] 暗霜 一些本地人提到在岛屿深处有一处巨大的地下洞窟结构。考虑到该岛的火山地质特征，存在一座古老熔岩腔的可能性极高。有关暗霜的入口记载极为稀少，任何能从地表进入的入口都可能在被发现后的几年内消失，这可能是由于地质活动频繁所致，这也阻碍了采矿作业。尽管如此，仍有少数幸运的冒险者得以一窥这片罕见的地下世界，并描述其中如梦似幻的美景，以及深不见底、晶莹剔透的湖泊。 此外，也有报告称一些皮肤苍白、具有精灵样貌且行为野蛮的居民，从散布于岛上的锻莫遗迹中走出。这些说法是否属实尚待证实，但未来的探险或许能提供更多的研究机会，从而让我们能更深入地了解这些古老遗迹。毕竟，若真有大量锻莫曾在此定居，那将彻底改变我们对他们在整个泰姆瑞尔大陆分布情况的认知。 [pagebreak] 最后安息之地 最后必须提及的是沃罗的长眠之所。这位声名狼藉的巫师最为人所知的事迹，就是他成功运用斯洛德人秘传的技术，将自己转化成了巫妖——这项行为及其背后的盟约，和许多其他死灵法术一样，在当时受到了法师公会的严厉谴责。 据说沃罗生前名为雷恩·马隆，他的化名源自古代龙祭司的语言。“Vulom”一词意指黑暗或阴影，恰如其分地体现了这位巫师所掌握的魔法类型。在法师公会多次围剿失败后，据说最终是由赛伊克教团亲自出手，才在一场激烈的法术对决中击败了这位巫妖。由于如此高声望的死灵法师极难被彻底消灭，因此人们将他的遗骸肢解并分散在了全岛各地，以防他日后复活。 关于他的私人生活及其是否与著名死灵法师曼尼马克有所关联的细节已不可考。但他墓穴及旧巢穴的残迹仍可在岛屿西南岸附近找到，若有学者胆敢前往探访，或能从中获得些许知识。

original: Anduril's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I've managed to strike a deal with the local rabble plundering the ruins; their protection in exchange for my scrying abilities. A fair exchange in my opinion, after-all the treasure found in the barrow is nothing compared to what lies deeper down and the Thalmor know it. A couple agents have already slipped by both us and the draugr but I swear I'll beat them to it. Don't get me wrong; it's not that I'm not sympathetic to the Aldmeri cause, I'd just rather that power rest in my hands not theirs.

We've been searching the barrow for weeks now but still haven't found a way deeper down into the lower delves of this gods-forsaken cess pit of an island. Writings by the local nords described a disposal chute of sorts for undesirables in the chamber of a long-dead dragon-priest warrior known only as Suleyk. Given his status among those of the dragon cult of old I suspect his chamber lies the furthest down. Perhaps the way to Dimfrost is through there; though we are met with stiff resistance, no pun intended, by legions of draugr every inch of the way.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
我设法与掠夺遗迹的当地暴徒达成了协议：我用占卜能力换取他们的保护。在我看来，这是一笔公平的交易，毕竟墓穴中找到的那些财宝，与更深之处隐藏的东西根本无法相提并论——而梭默也清楚这一点。已经有几个他们的特工悄悄穿过了我们和尸鬼的防线，但我发誓我一定会抢在他们前面。别误会，这并不是因为我对那些先祖神洲的人没有同情心，我只是更希望那股力量能掌握在我的手中，而不是他们手里。

original: Ruminations on Mudcrabs

[pagebreak]

Ruminations on Mudcrabs by Elmera

[pagebreak]

I write this not in jest, but to serve as a stern warning to those who take the existence of mudcrabs lightly. Given the pervasiveness of this aquatic menace along our coastal waterways I have decided to compose a song. Perform it at your local inn for tips. Look upon the sparkling waters and tell me what you see, A multitude of mudcrabs, numbering one, two and three. Oh they bite and they nip and they pinch and they snip, But lo and behold the devilspawn standing right before thee. Tarry not, be not afraid, draw your sword and strike, For nothing compares to the hell and fury of a mudcrab's bite. So take heed and remember now, don't leave it for too late, Or you too may one day meet with a terrible fate. Never underestimate a mudcrab; entire cities in Blackmarsh have fallen to this menance.
string:
[pagebreak]

对泥沼蟹的沉思 作者 艾奥米拉

[pagebreak]

我写这篇文章并非开玩笑，而是要严厉警告那些轻视泥沼蟹存在的人。鉴于这种水生威胁在我们沿海水道的普遍性，我决定创作一首歌。不妨在你附近的旅馆里演唱一下，获取一些建议。 看看那碧波粼粼的水面告诉我你看到了啥， 那儿有一堆泥沼蟹，个数正好是一二三。 哦它们抬起了钳子，又捏又掐又夹， 但是看啊，在我们面前的是一群魔鬼的后代。 别迟疑，别害怕，拔出剑来就是干， 因为被夹上一下你可会疼到家， 请留心，请记住，看到它可别大意， 否则你的小身板儿可会死得惨。 千万别小瞧了泥沼蟹，在黑沼泽，有许多城市都已被这种威胁所吞噬。

original: Dunyick's Note

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
Looks like something is stirring the draugr in the barrow. I've seen groups of them leave under the cover of darkness. I tracked them to an ice cave on the other side of the island; Haetar's Cave. It seems the Thalmor holed up there are somehow drawing their attention, but how I cannot say for sure. I suggest avoiding the road south of Fort Valus for now.

- Dunyick
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
看起来有什么东西在搅动古墓里的尸鬼。我看到它们成群结队地在夜幕的掩护下离开。我追踪它们到了岛另一边的一个冰洞；那洞穴叫做海塔尔的洞穴。似乎是藏在那里的梭默以某种方式吸引了它们的注意，但我无法确定这具体是如何做到的。我建议暂时远离瓦鲁斯堡南边的那条路。

- 顿雅克
</font>

original: Note To Initiates

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
A word of warning to our newest faces; leave the draugr in the lower levels be. They do a good job of guarding our spoils against the hapless intruders that blunder in from time to time. Anbeth has also outdone herself by rigging a bunch of traps around them so watch your step.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
给新人们的一份警告：别管那些在下面的尸鬼。那帮倒霉催的入侵者总是一次又一次地试图夺取我们的战利品，而它们可是对付入侵者们的最佳防线。安贝斯还在它们周围布置了不少陷阱，所以小心脚下。

original: Assassin's Note

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
Merkethe, it seems I was wrong about this place. Far from prying eyes, sure, though perhaps too far away. Work is few and far between and my brothers and sisters have already left to join the sanctuary in Falkreath. I, too, aim to join with them soon. Hope your hunt in Blackmarsh went well, heard there's a bit of trouble brewing down there as of late.

string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
莫克斯，看来我对这地方的看法是错的。这儿离窥视的目光很远，没错，是太远了。工作又少，还要跑远路，我的兄弟姐妹们都已经离开了这里，前往佛克瑞斯的圣所了。我想我过不了多久也会去他们那儿。愿你在黑沼泽的狩猎一切顺利，听说最近那里有点麻烦。

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Rest assured, the East Empire Company protects it's assets and, given the recent news from Skyrim, your report of a dragon sighting will be taken seriously.

However, do keep in mind that, at this stage, we do not consider dragon attacks as insurable disasters, or an 'act of the gods' if you will -- at least as far as we're concerned. Our stance on this issue may change once the impact of the dragon re-emergence can be properly assessed. For now, I urge you to keep an eye on the skies at all times and to reduce the amount of flammable material surrounding your home.

Regards,
Lurius Loire
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
请放心，东帝国公司一向保护其资产安全，鉴于最近从天际省传来的消息，你关于目击龙的报告我们会认真对待的。

然而，请记住，我们并不将龙的袭击视为可投保的灾难，或者说是“天灾”，至少在我们看来是这样。等对巨龙再次出现的影响进行了合理评估之后，我们对这个问题的立场才可能会有所改变。在此之前，我强烈建议你随时留意天空，并尽量减少住宅周围易燃物品的存放。

此致敬礼，
卢里乌斯·里奥尔
</font>

original: Amarth's Note
I'm out of breath and all my muscles ache. It feels like spikes with every step I take. My heart beats, it's about to burst. This day my luck turned to the worse.
string: 我上气不接下气，全身肌肉酸痛。我每走一步都感觉像踩到钉子一样。我的心脏都快跳出来了。今天我的运气简直糟透了。

original: Vampire Warning

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>The Vigilants of Stendarr are hereby issuing a warning to any travelers in the area to stay away from the cave known as Bloodfrost Burrow. Located on the eastern side of Wyrmstooth, vampires have been spotted in the vicinity and we believe they are holed up inside.

We plan to march on their den soon and put them to the sword. If any able bodied adventurers would like to join our crusade, the vampire's spoils will be your reward. Our mission is simply one of purification.

- Amon of the Vigilants of Stendarr
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>斯丹达尔警戒者特此向向所有途经此地的旅行者发出警告，请远离被称为血霜地洞的洞穴。该洞穴位于龙牙岛的东侧，在附近发现了吸血鬼，我们相信它们正藏匿于洞穴深处。

我们计划在近期向他们的巢穴进军，将其尽数斩杀。如果有身强力壮的冒险者愿意加入我们的队伍，吸血鬼的战利品将是你们的报酬。 我们的使命仅仅是净化邪恶。

- 斯丹达尔警戒者 阿蒙
</font>

original: Note of Concern

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">I know everyone is busy getting Stonehollow back up and running, but can someone check in on the dockmaster over near Fort Moonwatch? He was supposed to meet with the new Imperial contingent stationed at Fort Moonwatch, but he never showed up.

I'm sure the old sod is fine, but if someone could go over there just to make sure I'd appreciate it.

-- Hulgard
</font>
string:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">我知道每个人都在忙着让巨石空谷恢复运转，但是有没有人能去帮我看看观月堡附近的码头负责人？ 他本该去和前来观月堡驻扎的新一批帝国特遣队会面的，但他一直没露面。

original: Fort Valus Note

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>Fort Valus, situated to the south of Stonehollow, has sat abandoned for far too long. In the interests of safeguarding the southern passage against marauders, we are seeking new occupants to staff the fort. Those interested in providing common services such as smithing, gardening, cooking, cleaning, security and entertainment will be paid a generous wage by the East Empire Company.

For those interested in purchasing the deed to the land, please see me here at Stonehollow for negotiations.

-- Lurius Liore
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>位于巨石空谷南部的瓦鲁斯堡已经废弃太久了。为了保护南部通道免受掠夺者的侵害，我们正在寻找新的驻地人员来管理堡垒。有意提供锻造、园艺、烹饪、清洁、安保和娱乐等公共服务的人员，将由东帝国公司支付丰厚的工资。

有意购买地契的人，请来巨石空谷找我进行洽谈。

——卢里乌斯·里奥尔

original: Miner's Warning

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">Attention,

Any travelers passing by the steampools should avoid Gronndal Grove until Imperial reinforcements arrive. We've been mining a rare ebony vein near the steampools but it would seem that our excavations have led us into a spriggan lair. We lost several miners to them, gods rest their souls.

If any able bodied mercenaries or adventurers are interested in providing us with assistance, we can offer 800 gold to anyone able to clear out the spriggans for us.

- Bolmar
</font>
string:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">注意，

在帝国的援军到达之前，任何途经蒸汽池的旅行者都应该避开格隆达尔森林。 我们一直在蒸汽池附近开采稀有的黑檀矿，但我们的挖掘工作似乎将我们带入了一个木灵巢穴。 我们失去了几个矿工，上帝保佑他们的灵魂得到安息。

如果有任何身强力壮的雇佣兵或冒险者有兴趣帮助我们，我们可以提供800金币给任何能够为我们清除木灵的人。

original: Dunyick's Request

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">To any able bodied mercenary reading this,

I have been tracking a group of marauders that have set up camp near Chillwater Mill. These marauders have been responsible for harrasing the good citizens of the mill and seizing assets belonging to the East Empire Company. It's time they were dealt with appropriately.

I seek a blade for hire to drive these marauders away, or put them out of their misery. The reward of 200 gold will be yours upon completion of this job. See me at my camp for more information. Directions have been attached to this leaflet.

- Dunyick
</font>
string:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">致任何读到这封信的身体健康的雇佣兵。

我一直在追踪一群在寒水锯木厂附近扎营的掠夺者。 这些掠夺者一直在骚扰锯木厂的善良公民，并抢夺属于东帝国公司的财产。 是时候处理他们了。

我想找一个雇佣兵，把这些掠夺者赶走，或者让他们脱离苦海。完成这项工作后，你将获得200金币的奖励。如需了解更多信息，请前往我的营地咨询。路线指南已附于此传单。

- 顿雅克
</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Those damn marauders are swarming like vultures. More of them seem drawn to the island ever since the dragon attacks begun. Perhaps they're waiting for an opportunity to overrun the mining settlement and kick what little influence the empire has here off the island.

The hunters tell me the dragon was last seen flying south over the ocean towards Skyrim; perhaps to follow that big black dragon we saw first. They say it's unlikely to return but I have a bad feeling about this. As long as I have Faelor by my side I feel like I can somehow manage.

string:

那帮该死的掠夺者就像秃鹫一样蜂拥而至，自从巨龙袭击之后，就有越来越多的掠夺者跑到这座岛上来。或许他们正在等待一个好机会，好把这岛上少得可怜的帝国兵们给赶走，然后一举占领这个采矿定居点。

On behalf of the Baywater Bandits I am writing to propose a temporary truce with the Blackfist Marauders. Our enemy is common: the Thalmor. Their recent incursion onto Wyrmstooth affects both of us and I know for a fact that you've suffered the same number of casualties that we have.

original: Bloodstained Note

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
Their numbers are countless. I collapsed the entrance but even now I can hear them clawing through the ice. The ward is beginning to weaken; I fear my demise is inevitable.

It's that damn wizard's doing. Alberthor, curse his name! Mark my words; the Thalmor will get what we came for. If he will not hand it over to us willingly we will come and take it from him by force. It is crucial, no, it is climatic in our plight.

He claims ignorance of its existence but I know it's all a lie. He of all people would know.

string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
他们的数量不计其数。尽管我已将入口封死，但直到现在我仍能听见他们在冰层中抓挠的声音。结界已经越来越虚弱了，恐怕我的死期已不可避免。

这一切都是那个该死的法师干的好事。奥尔博特，老子诅咒你！记住我的话：梭默终将夺得我们此行的目标物。如果他不肯主动交出来，我们就用武力夺回。那东西至关重要，不，这关系到我们目前的处境。

他声称对那东西的存在一无所知，但我知道那就是在撒谎。要说谁最了解那东西——非他莫属。
</font>

original: Thalmor Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Life on this island has so far been as miserable as one would expect. Most days are shrouded by a thick mist and in the rare instances it clears enough for us to see the main island we see naught but jagged mountains reaching skyward as if to challenge the gods. Still, I know our quarry will be well worth the suffering we must endure.

For the moment we've set up camp on a small crag to the north-west of the main island. Our scouts indicate the nearby ruins to the south are currently occupied by a moderately-sized coven of witches, perhaps led by one or more hagravens. It appears that they are aware of our presence as well and have begun raising undead to fortify the surrounding marsh. If we are to establish a more permanent base we should make haste and eliminate them as soon as possible. With our current numbers we should be able to accomplish this with minimal loss.

The recent lack of communication from Norano has led me to assume that he has met an untimely end. Perhaps this is the old wizard's doing? Last I heard he had fortified himself in an ice cave on the eastern side of the island after being pursued by nordic undead. If he doesn't send word within the next two days I'm listing him as deceased. At the very least his sacrifice will make it easier for us to stretch our meagre supplies.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
到目前为止，这个岛上的生活正如所预料的那样悲惨。大部分的日子都被浓雾笼罩，只有极少数的时候天气晴朗，那时我们才能看到主岛以及高耸入云的群山，仿佛在挑战众神。尽管如此，我知道我们的猎物值得我们承受这些痛苦。

目前我们在主岛西北部的一块小峭壁上扎营。我们的斥候指出，南方不远处的遗迹目前被一个中等规模的女巫集会所占据，可能由一个或多个乌鸦鬼婆领导。他们似乎也意识到了我们的存在，并且开始召唤亡灵来保护周围的沼泽。如果我们要建立一个更持久的基地，就应该抓紧时间消灭她们。以我们目前的人数来看，我们应该能够以最小的损失完成这一任务。

诺拉诺最近没有和我联系，我只能假设他已经遭遇了不测。也许是那个老巫师干的？上次我听说他在被诺德亡灵追赶后，就躲在了岛屿东侧的一个冰洞里。如果他在接下来两天内仍无音讯，我会将他列为阵亡人员。至少他的牺牲能让我们勉强维持的补给更加宽裕一些。
</font>

original: Witch's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
As if we didn't have enough headaches, first it was the marauders stealing our shipments then it was the dragon burning down the caravans. But now we have to deal with the Thalmor as well?

They arrived a week ago and set up camp along the coast just a short distance from our fort. I've bolstered our defenses the best I could in the short time we've had and called upon the sisters to raise as many skeletons as they can muster. I know, it's not much of an army. Skeletons are traditionally frail but Agneta's necromantic prowess has been able to bolster their strength. It might be enough to ward off the Thalmor at least for now.

In a very strange turn of events it would seem that the dwemer cube we traded to the dockmaster in exchange for facilitating the delivery of supplies from High Rock has returned to our possession. One of our sisters dispatched a small party of marauders that encroached the waters nearby the castle near Horker Isle, lo and behold one of them had the cube on their person. I can only assume that means the dockmaster met an untimely death by their hands...

I plan on trading the cube to the warlocks at Krakevisa in exchange for their assistance in dealing with the Thalmor. Despite our past rivalries i'm sure they can understand the problem the Thalmor will pose if they are allowed to continue amassing their forces here.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
好像我们的头疼事还不够多一样，先是掠夺者偷走了我们的货物，然后是恶龙烧毁了商队。而现在我们还得去处理那群梭莫？

他们在一周前到达这里，并在离我们堡垒不远的海岸边扎营。我已经在有限的时间内尽可能加强了防御，并请求姐妹们尽可能多地召唤骷髅士兵。我知道，这算不上什么军队。骷髅一向是脆弱的，但阿格妮塔在死灵法术上的造诣已经增强了它们的力量。至少眼下应该足以抵挡梭莫了。

事情发生了非常奇怪的变化，我们之前为了方便从高岩运送物资而与码头负责人交易的那个锻莫魔方似乎又回到了我们手中。我们的一个姐妹在海象岛附近水域击退了一小队靠近城堡的掠夺者，结果你猜怎么着？其中一个人身上带着魔方。我只能猜测，那位码头负责人恐怕已经被他们干掉了……

我计划把魔方交给克瑞克维萨的术士，以换取他们协助我们对付梭莫。尽管我们过去曾有过节，但我相信他们一定明白：如果允许这群梭莫继续在这里集结军队，对他们自己也将会是个大麻烦。
</font>

original: Donnar's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I suspect I may have been spotted by a group of marauders from Cragwater while poking around the ruins. For now I'll need to lay low and wait for an opportunity to slip away. The good news however is that I happened upon what appears to be some sort of pedestal of dwarven origin, so perhaps what the witches spoke of was true after all. The only problem being that I don't see anything nearby that even remotely resembles an entrance. I wonder what exactly this cube is meant to do? I know the dwarves were an ingenious bunch, but surely not so ingenious as to be able to render an entire citadel hidden from plain sight?
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
我怀疑我可能是在废墟附近闲逛的时候被一群从涌水峭岩来的掠夺者发现了。现在我需要保持低调，并等待机会溜走。不过好消息是，我偶然发现了一个看起来像是矮人制造的基座，所以女巫们说的那些事也许都是真的。唯一的问题是我在附近没有看到任何类似入口的东西。我想知道这个魔方到底是用来做什么的？我知道矮人都很聪明，但肯定没有聪明到能把整栋建筑都隐藏起来吧？
</font>

original: Marauder's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Seems like Wylfharth and his crew caught an imperial scout slinking around the old dwemer ruins at the lake near Haetar's cave. Normally they know to stay well away from our side of the island. After some time on the rack he mentioned something about his employer recently coming into possession of a dwemer cube that would open the entrance to a sealed ruin in the area. This could be a fortuitous find indeed and our storeroom at Blind Robber's Bluff has space yet for more treasure.

I'll send a couple men over by boat to relieve the dockmaster of his little acquisition then put together a crew to plunder the ruin. By the sounds of it, a small group recently pushed through Fort Moonwatch from the docks so they're going to have to make their approach from the north if they want to avoid contact with the Imperial soldiers returning from the mainland.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
似乎威尔法斯和他的手下抓住了一个帝国斥候，那人在海塔尔的洞穴附近湖边的锻莫遗址周围鬼鬼祟祟的打转。通常情况下，他们是知道要远离我们的岛屿的。在拷问了一段时间后，他交代了他的雇主最近获得了一个锻莫魔方，它可以打开该地区一处封闭遗迹的入口。这可真是个难得的好消息，我们在盲盗断崖的储藏室还有一些空间来存放新的宝藏。

我会先派几个人坐船过去，从码头负责人那里把那个“小收获”取来，然后再召集一支队伍去搜刮遗迹。听那斥候的说法，最近似乎有一小群人从码头突破了观月堡，所以如果我们的人想避免和从大陆回来的帝国士兵接触，就得从北方绕路。

original: Dockmaster's Journal

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
In payment for the safe delivery of supplies from High Rock, the witches of Belonir offered me a strange cube and told me it would unseal a dwarven cache on the eastern side of the island worth many times the gold to cover their expenses. I'm no newcomer to this island, been living here for the good part of three decades now and I know there are many dwarven ruins to the east, most of which are filled to the brim with deadly traps.

Seems the witches are aware of this as well. I asked them why they haven't used the cube themselves to unlock the cache but they tell me alchemical ingredients and tomes of knowledge are worth more to them than gold. What a load of horse shit, gold can certainly buy plenty of both. They just don't want to have to do the dirty work themselves. Sounds about right for a coven so weak they needed to flee the mainland to keep practicing their dark arts.

Still, if there's a dwarven ruin out there that has remained sealed against plunderers and dungeon delvers then perhaps setting up a little expedition crew might be worth the effort. Now the only problem is finding enough willing swordarms. Even if I could pay in advance it seems the Imperials are busy contending with the dragon that burned down Stonehollow. For now I'll send Donnar to scout the area and confirm whether the witches speak true, otherwise the crew I put together will be marching on their lair instead.
</font>
string:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
为了感谢我安全将补给从高岩运送到岛上，贝隆尼的女巫们送了我一个奇怪的魔方，并告诉我它能开启岛屿东侧的一处锻莫储藏室，里面的东西价值连城，远超我为她们垫付的费用。我对这座岛可不陌生，我已经在这里住了将近三十年了，我知道东部是有许多锻莫遗迹，但其中大多数都布满了致命的陷阱。

看来这些女巫也知道这一点。我问她们为什么不自己用这个魔方去打开藏宝地，她们却告诉我炼金材料和知识典籍对她们来说比金币更有价值。简直是一派胡言！金币完全能买来这两样东西。她们不过是不想亲自动手干脏活罢了。这倒也符合那帮懦弱的女巫——弱到必须逃到岛上才能继续搞她们的黑暗巫术。

不过话说回来，如果真有一处锻莫遗迹至今未被掠夺者和地城探险者染指，那么组织一支小小的远征队或许值得一试。现在唯一的问题是找不到足够的武装人员。就算我能预付报酬，帝国士兵们似乎也正忙于应对那条烧毁巨石空谷的龙。我暂时会先派唐纳去侦察那片区域，确认女巫是否所言属实。否则的话，我召集起来的这支队伍恐怕就得直接杀向她们的老巢了。
</font>

original: Spellmaker's Letter

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
The years of work that went into researching the spriggan's natural ability to command animals have finally paid off. Sure, it was hard studying live samples without having the life drained from me, but the results have been worth it. A spell that controls all nearby undead, if only for a short time. With this, perhaps we now have the power to drive the marauders from the island for good.

多年来我一直致力于研究木灵控制动物的天赋能力，现在终于有了回报。当然，要在不耗尽我生命的情况下研究活体样本很困难，但最终的结果是值得的。这是一种可以控制附近所有亡灵的法术，虽然只是短暂的。有了这个，也许我们现在有能力把这些掠夺者永远赶出这个岛了。

original: An Explorer's Guide to Wyrmstooth

[pagebreak]

An Explorer's Guide to Wyrmstooth by Harryotz Patokia

[pagebreak]

ure, my travels through this cold and unforgiving land have been fraught with peril. Many times have I found myself at the mercy of a hungry bear or at the business end of a marauder's blade. However, despite the danger, this land has a lonesome beauty to it that beckons me to stay. Peering across the sea toward the crumbling ruins of Belonir's Borg hovering in the distance above a thin veneer of fog remains a most memorable sight and one that I will cherish for the rest of my life, as short as that may be on this island. For those keen with blade or spell I implore you; seek out the following locations and behold this island's beauty for yourself. Far to the north-west you can find a location known locally only as Dead Ship Point. A place of quiet repose and the final resting place of numerous vessels caught in the storms that savage the sea of ghosts. As far as treasure is concerned, I'm afraid most of these ships have been picked clean long ago by the marauders or treasure hunters from the mainland. Along the east of the island you may find what is now a lake hidden amongst the glaciers. Long ago the dwemer built a city here. Many ruins can be seen sticking out of the ice but the entrance was rumoured to be somewhere beneath this lake. There are few brave enough to explore its depths but it would prove to be one of the few ruins on this island untouched by human hands for a thousand years or more. Not too long ago Fort Valus used to be garrisoned by the Imperials in an effort to safeguard the southern shipping passage from seafaring banditry. Sadly, with the state of the civil war raging on the mainland, the unrest in other provinces, not to mention the dragon crisis, the Imperial presence here on Wyrmstooth has been scaled back and the fort fell into abandonment. Sometimes, on clear days, one may see the highest peaks of Skyrim rising out of the ocean. But perhaps it's just a trick of the imagination? As I mentioned earlier, Belonir's Borg is quite a sight to behold but even moreso up close. An old Imperial fortification now crumbling into the ocean, what remains of it is now in the hands of a coven of witches that use its halls for all manner of dark arts. If you manage to climb up the cliffs without being spotted, the view of the rest of the island is quite remarkable. Lastly, and probably the reason you came to this island in the first place, I must mention Wyrmstooth barrow. Nestled amongst the mountains on the eastern side of the island it serves as the primary reason most adventurers come here; to put their mettle to the test in one of the largest dungeons in Tamriel. Though most of its valuables have been picked clean by marauders over the years, adventurers tell tales of hidden rooms and secret passageways undisturbed for centuries so who truly knows how large this old nordic ruin truly is.
string:
[pagebreak]

龙牙岛探险指南 哈约斯·帕托基亚 著

[pagebreak]

诚然，我在这片寒冷无情的土地上的旅行充满了危险。有很多次，我都不得不面对饥饿的熊，或直面掠夺者的刀锋。然而，尽管险象环生，这片土地却有一种孤独的美，吸引着我驻足流连。当我凝视海面，望向远方雾气中若隐若现的贝隆尼的堡垒，那残破的轮廓是我一生中最难忘的景象——即便在岛上我的生命可能短暂如蜉蝣。 致那些精通刀剑或魔法的勇士们，我在此诚挚地恳请你们：请循着指引去探访下列地点，亲眼去领略这座岛屿的绝世之美。 在岛屿的西北方向，你可以找到一个被当地人称作亡船角的地方。这是一个安静的地方，也是许多被肆虐于幽灵海的风暴吞噬的船只的最后安息之所。至于某些人关注的宝藏，这些船只恐怕早已被来自大陆的掠夺者或寻宝者搜刮一空。 沿着岛屿的东侧前行，你会发现一个隐藏在冰川中的湖泊。很久以前锻莫在这里建了一座城市。如今，你可以看到许多遗迹从冰层中探出头来，据说入口就藏在这湖底某处，很少有人敢深入探索。这或许会是这座岛上为数不多、千余年来未被人染指过的遗迹之一。 不久之前，瓦鲁斯堡还驻扎着帝国军团，以保护南部航道不受海上盗匪的侵扰。不幸的是，随着内战在大陆的肆虐，其他省份也动乱不安，再加上龙灾肆虐，龙牙岛上的帝国驻军正日渐缩减，这座堡垒也被遗弃了。有时在晴朗的日子里，你可以看到天际的最高峰从海洋中升起。但也许这只是幻觉？ 就像我之前提到的，贝隆尼的堡垒壮观无比，若近距离细观，更是令人叹为观止。这是一座古老的帝国防御工事，如今正逐渐崩塌坠入大海，其残存的部分落入了一个女巫团的手中，她们利用堡内的厅堂，施展着各种各样的黑魔法。如果你能在不被发现的情况下爬上悬崖，便能将岛屿其余部分的景色尽收眼底，那景象将会格外壮观。 最后，可能也是你最初来到这个岛的原因，我必须提一提龙牙古坟。它坐落在岛屿东部的群山之中，是大多数冒险家来到这里的主要原因：在泰姆瑞尔大陆最大的地城之一里考验自己的胆识与身手。虽然多年以来，大部分贵重物品早已被掠夺者搜刮殆尽，但冒险者之间仍在口耳相传关于隐藏房间和秘密通道的传说——据说那些地方已经沉寂了几个世纪。所以，没人知道这座古老的诺德遗迹究竟有何等广阔。

original: And the promise of a generous reward. Sounds tempting, if I were you I'd best not keep him waiting.
string: 当然奖励也是很丰厚的。听起来挺棒的不是吗，如果我是你的话我可不会让他久等。

original: Ah you made it, I was beginning to think you were never going to show up.
string: 啊你终于来了，我还以为你再也不会出现了。

original: I received your message. Sounds like you're having trouble with a dragon?
string: 我收到你的信息了。听说你有头棘手的龙要对付？

original: Heard you might be the person to speak to when it comes to dealing with these sorts of things.
string: 而我听说，若要处理这类棘手事务，你便是那个最合适的人选。

original: The problem is straightforward enough, I suppose. A dragon has been attacking trade shipments throughout the holds.
string: 问题本身倒也简单。有一条龙一直在袭击各个领地的贸易物资。

original: Perhaps you've seen the carriages burning by the roadside during your travels?
string: 也许你在旅途中已经见过路边燃烧的马车了？

original: Contingents of soldiers have already been sent after it, obviously to no success, and we need a solution before this problem gets out of hand.
string: 虽然我们已经派了好几队士兵去追捕它，但显然毫无成效。我们必须在事态失控前找到解决办法。

original: Oh, but where are my manners. Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Lurius Liore, and I'm with the East Empire Company.
string: 噢——瞧我这失礼的。请允许我自我介绍。我的名字是卢里乌斯·里奥尔，隶属于东帝国公司。

original: I had to make a few stops first, you know how it is.
string: 我先去了几个别的地方办事，你懂的。

original: Well, I'm glad you've got the luxury of time. Unfortunately for us, we may not be so fortunate.
string: 嗯，我很羡慕你能有闲工夫到处闲逛。但对我们而言，恐怕就没那么幸运了。

original: Why is the East Empire Company getting involved?
string: 东帝国公司为什么要介入此事？

original: Because it's our trade shipments that are being destroyed by that dragon.
string: 因为那条龙正在摧毁我们的贸易物资。

original: Supplies in the holds are dwindling as it is, no thanks to that Stormcloak uprising and the subsequent rise in banditry.
string: 各领地的物资本来就因为风暴斗篷的叛乱和随之而来的强盗横行而所剩无几了。

original: So, we've been co-operating with the Jarls to pool our resources together towards funding a solution.
string: 因此，我们一直在与各位领主合作，集中资源来解决这个问题。

original: A collective bounty of 10,000 gold has been placed on this dragon, to pique the interest of skilled mercenaries.
string: 我们已经对这条巨龙悬赏了一万金币，希望能引起一些高人的兴趣。

original: What kind of plan did you have in mind?
From those that answered the call, I have personally chosen 4 highly proficient mercenaries and I want you to lead them into battle.
string: 从那些响应号召的人中，我亲自挑选了4名非常老练的佣兵，我希望你能带领他们投入战斗。

original: Their skills and backgrounds are diverse, because we need to be ready for any challenge that we may be faced with.
string: 他们的技能和背景是各不相同，因为我们需要为可能面临的各种挑战做好万全准备。

original: Why hire mercenaries?
This is no ordinary dragon we're dealing with.
It has proven to be very calculating in its attacks, specifically targeting our trade shipments to slowly starve Skyrim from the inside out.
string: 它的攻击手段极其狡诈且充满算计，专门针对我们的贸易物资下手，企图从内部慢慢扼杀天际省的生机。

original: Every battle our soldiers have had with it, we've been caught at a disadvantage.
string: 每次我们派出士兵与它交战，都处于劣势。

original: It may have a motive that we don't yet understand, and I don't want to risk throwing more Imperial soldiers at it in vain.
string: 它可能怀有我们尚未了解的动机，我不愿再白白牺牲更多帝国士兵的生命。

original: The team I've assembled have been tracking the dragon from its last known sighting near Falkreath.
string: 我召集的小队一直在追踪那条龙，它上一次出现在佛克瑞斯附近。

original: By now they should know where it's going, and if we're lucky we might even be able to take it by surprise this time.
string: 现在他们应该已经摸清它的去向了，如果我们这次足够幸运，甚至有望打它个措手不及。

original: That's where you'll come in.
string: 而这就是轮到你出场的时候了。

original: You're back. I was beginning to think you may never return. I trust you bring good news?
string: 你回来了。我还以为你再也回不来了呢。我相信你带来了好消息？

original: Unfortunately not. It was expecting us and managed to slip away.
string: 不幸的是没有。它预料到了我们的行动，并且设法溜走了。

original: I see. Were you at least able to find anything out about why it was attacking our trade shipments?
string: 我明白了。那你至少应该查出它为何要袭击我们的贸易物资了吧？

original: The attacks were a ruse. It aims to lure us to an island called Wyrmstooth.
string: 这些袭击只是一个诱饵。它的真正目的是引诱我们前往一个叫龙牙岛的岛屿。

original: Wyrmstooth? Then it seems that once again that dragon has slipped out of my grasp. I was hoping it wouldn't come to this.
string: 龙牙岛？看来这条龙又一次从我的手中溜走了。我本希望事情不会发展到这一步的。

original: I manage Stonehollow, an East Empire Company mining settlement.
string: 我管理着东帝国公司的采矿定居点巨石空谷。

original: It's located on the island of Wyrmstooth to the north of Solitude, in the Sea of Ghosts.
string: 它位于独孤城以北的幽灵海岛屿，龙牙岛。

original: Our particular dragon was first sighted near the mining settlement, but it never attacked us directly.
string: 我们追捕的这条龙最初是在采矿定居点附近被发现的，但它从未直接攻击过我们。

original: Not one to let a potential problem fester, I brought it to the attention of the Empire and a legion was dispatched to deal with it.
string: 我不想让这个隐患恶化，于是把它上报给了帝国，随后一支军团就被派了过来处理此事。

original: Sadly, they proved to be no match for that dragon.
string: 可悲的是，很明显他们不是那条龙的对手。

original: So what happened next?
All accounts suggest it headed south, to mainland Skyrim.
string: 所有的迹象都表明它一路向南，去了天际大陆。

original: Shortly thereafter, I began hearing reports of East Empire Company trade shipments being burned,
string: 此后不久，我便开始陆续收到东帝国公司的贸易物资被烧毁的报告，

original: with surviving witnesses all describing the same dragon.
string: 幸存的目击者都描述了同一条龙。

original: So I traveled south in pursuit of it, hoping to find a way to put an end to the problem before it had a chance to return.
string: 于是我南下追寻，希望能在它卷土重来之前找到解决问题的方法。

original: I convinced the East Empire Company to work together with the Jarls to raise a bounty on that dragon.
string: 我说服了东帝国公司与领主们共同发起对那条龙的悬赏。

original: And sent Theodyn, my courier, to track down the one person that might give us an edge over that beast. You.
string: 并派我的信使西奥迪，去寻找那个或许能帮助我们战胜那头凶兽的关键人物。也就是你。

original: Good, you made it. I know it's not much, but this ship will get us to Wyrmstooth in one piece
string: 很好，你来了。我知道这船看着并不怎么样，但它能把我们完好无损地送到龙牙岛。

original: Let me know when you're ready and I'll tell the captain to set sail.
string: 如果你准备好了就告诉我，我会叫船长起航。

original: Just be sure you're fully equipped and stocked up on whatever you'll need before we depart.
string: 在我们出发之前，请确保你已经准备齐全。

original: I'm ready to go.
Great. I'll let everyone know we're ready to set sail.
string: 好的。我会通知其他人我们准备出发了。

original: Head below deck and get some shut eye. It'll take a few hours for us to get there and we'll need to be fully rested to face whatever is in store.
string: 到甲板下面去睡一会吧。我们还需要几个小时才能到达那里，我们需要养精蓄锐，以应对即将发生的一切。

original: I need to prepare myself first.
Very well. You should be able to stock up on supplies in Solitude. But don't keep us waiting too long.
string: 当然，你可以在独孤城好好补给一下。但别让我们等太久。

original: Let's go. Once I've spoken with the others, we'll make our way to Stonehollow.
string: 我们走。等我和其他人谈完，我们就去巨石空谷。

original: Alright, listen up everyone. That monster is out there on this island. It knows we're here and it likely has a trap prepared for us.
string: 好了，大家听好了。那怪物就在这个岛上的某个地方。它知道我们追来了，所以很可能已经为我们准备好了陷阱。

original: No second chances. No letting it get away this time or none of us are getting paid. Do I make myself clear? Great. Let's move out.
string: 机不可失时不再来，这次要是再让它逃了，那我们谁也拿不到钱。我说得够清楚了吗？好极了，开始行动。

original: Many people come to this island seeking to make a fortune from the rich ore veins.
string: 许多人来这个岛都是想找个富矿发财。

original: What they don't realize is how tough mining ore really is. Many leave not long after they arrive.
string: 但他们没有意识到开采矿石是一件多么艰苦的差事。很多人来了没多久就离开了。

original: As a result, this island is littered with old mine shafts. Tombstones and shattered dreams.
string: 因此，这座岛上到处都是废弃的矿井，墓碑，以及那些破碎的梦想。

original: Some remain abandoned, while others fall into the hands of marauders and other ne'er-do-wells that use them to hide from the Empire.
string: 有些矿井至今荒废着，而另一些则落入了掠夺者和其他恶徒之手，他们利用这些矿井来躲避帝国的追捕。

original: As you can see, this entire island is essentially one big volcanic crater. See the barrow up there? That's where we're headed.
string: 正如你所见，这整座岛本质上就是个巨大的火山口。看到上面那座古坟了吗？我们的目的地就在那里。

original: We'd set up a settlement here if it was safe to do so, if it weren't so close to the marauder's main encampment that is.
string: 如果这里足够安全，我们本想在此建立定居点的——但它离掠夺者的主营地太近了。

original: Still, some try and tough it out here and stake new claims, if they're lucky enough to find anything before meeting a horrible fate.
string: 不过，还是有那么些人尝试在这里坚持下去，重新开辟矿场——如果他们够幸运，能在遭遇可怕的命运之前找到些什么的话。

original: By all the Gods, what a disaster. They never stood a chance.
string: 圣灵啊，这简直是一场灾难。他们根本没有机会。

original: I... I can't even begin to imagine how we're going to recover from this.
string: 我……我都无法想象我们要如何从这场浩劫中恢复过来。

original: All the lives lost...
We need to find that beast and end it before it has the chance to take any more lives.
string: 我们必须找到那头野兽，赶在它夺走更多性命之前解决它。

original: Damn it, looks like the gate is shut. Something used to slot into that pedestal over there. My guess is that's what controls the gate.
string: 该死，看来这座大门被锁住了。大概需要把什么东西插入到那个底座，我猜那个底座就是用来控制大门的。

original: What ever it was, it looks like it was only recently removed.
string: 不管那东西是什么，看起来似乎是最近才被取走的。

original: Look around for clues. Maybe we can find out what happened here.
string: 四处找找线索吧。也许我们能搞清楚这里到底发生了什么。

original: More vagrants? Did I not tell you already that you'll get what you want? By Shor's bones, I need more time!
string: 又是一群流浪汉？我不是已经告诉过你们了吗——你们想要的东西迟早会到手的！舒尔在上，再给我点时间好吗！

original: Wait, you're not one of those cut-throat smugglers, are you? Explain yourself, before I immolate you in hellfire.
string: 等等，你该不是那些冷血的恶棍吧？说清楚你的来意，否则我就用地狱之火把你烧成灰烬。

original: I'm chasing a dragon that came from this island. Perhaps you know about it?
string: 我在追踪一头从这座岛飞出来的龙。也许你知道些什么？

original: Ahh, I suppose that's what all the commotion was about then.
string: 啊，我想这就是为什么刚才会那么吵闹吧。

original: The rabble plundering these ruins of its riches mentioned something about their shipments being jeopardized.
string: 那些在这片废墟里搜刮财宝的乌合之众曾提到过，他们的货物运输受到了威胁。

original: But honestly, dragons? Maybe it was a cliff racer? They have been known to grow quite large.
string: 但是说真的，你确定是龙？或许只是峭壁行者什么的吧，它们确实有可能长得很大。

original: What the bandits speak of is correct. The dragons have indeed returned.
string: 那些强盗们说的是真的。龙已经回来了。

original: Well, I suppose that is quite something, then.
string: 好吧，那可真是摊上大事咯。

original: This island is the caldera of an ancient volcano and the barrow itself is built into the mountains.
string: 这座岛其实是一座古老火山的火山口，而那座古坟本身就建在山体之中。

original: I know of a way deeper down, through these ruins, into the magma chamber. That's likely where you'll find your dragon.
string: 我知道一条通往更深处的通道，能穿过这些遗迹，直通岩浆室。你要找的龙很可能就在那里。

original: But there is one slight dilemma...
string: 不过……眼下有个小小的难题……

original: What kind of a dilemma?
Follow me and I'll show you.
As you can see, a bit of a dilemma.
string: 正如你所见，这就那是个难题。

original: How do we get the gate open. And what's with the Draugr?
string: 我们要怎么打开这扇门？还有那个尸鬼是怎么回事？

original: This? Oh, this is ... how shall I say it ... part of my experiment. I've been researching the draugr here for quite some time now.
string: 这个嘛……哦，这个是……该怎么说呢……是我实验的一部分。我已经在这里研究这些尸鬼好一段时间了。

original: It's a bit of a silly story, really. While testing a new spell that I had been *hastily* working on, no thanks to these boneheads, I ... err ...
string: 这事说起来有点丢人，真的。当时我正在测试一个仓促赶制出来的新法术——多亏了这些蠢骨头，我……呃……

original: Had a bit of an accident. I must admit, I'm still working out the kinks of the new spell myself. It's not entirely ready, in case you didn't realise.
string: 发生了一点小事故。老实说，我自己也还在调试这个新法术的细节。它还没完全准备好，如果你还没看出来的话。

original: What kind of an accident?
The spell I've been working on allows me, well anyone really, to control the draugr. At least to some degree.
string: 我正在研究的这个法术……它能让我，好吧，也可以让任何人——在某种程度上控制尸鬼。

original: That draugr must've accidentally pushed a switch somewhere ahead of us, subsequently closing this gate.
string: 我想那个尸鬼可能是在无意中触发了前方某个机关，导致这扇大门关闭了。

original: I was preparing this for my next attempt. Good that you showed up just now. There's a little something I've been wanting to try...
string: 我正打算再来一次实验呢，你们正好就在这个时候出现了。我这儿有几个点子，一直想找机会试一试……

original: I don't like where this is going.
Oh, don't worry. It's perfectly safe. Well, relatively safe, at least for you it will be ... I think.
string: 哦别担心，这绝对安全。呃，相对安全吧，我想……至少对你来说应该是的。

original: I've been wanting to find out whether I can transfer control to another person. To allow somebody else to control the subject I've prepared.
string: 我一直想找个机会试试我能不能把控制权转移给另一个人，让其他人也能控制我已经准备好的实验对象。

original: If I can get a positive result out of this experiment, I can finally finish the spell and even expand on it further!
string: 如果我能在这次实验中取得积极成果，我就能最终完善这个法术，甚至进一步扩展它的用途！

original: And by that I mean having control over living things too! Animals ... people ... well, some control at least ... and only for a short time.
string: 我的意思是，不仅能控制死物，还能控制活的东西！比如动物……人……当然只是有限的控制……而且只能维持一小段时间。

original: So what do you say, ready to give this old draugr a spin? I don't think we can get this gate open right now by other any means.
string: 所以，你怎么说？准备好让这个老尸鬼活动一下了吗？我想我们现在也没有其他办法能打开这扇门了。

original: I guess I don't have much of a choice. I'm ready.
string: 我想我没得选。我准备好了。

original: Excellent. Just remember to keep going until you find that switch. It's there ... somewhere ... I'll end the spell once the gate is open.
string: 太棒了！记住要一直往前走，直到找到那个开关。它就在……某个地方……等门一开我就解除法术。

original: Now stand still while I cast this, it might tingle ... slightly.
string: 现在站着别动，我要施法了，可能会有……一点点疼。

original: I don't think I'm ready yet.
Very well, speak to me again when you're ready for me to cast the spell. I'll be waiting for you here.
string: 好吧，等你准备好了就来找我，我会在这儿等着的。

original: I'm ready for you to cast that spell now.
string: 我已经准备好了，施法吧。

original: Excellent. Just remember to keep going until you find that switch. It's there ... somewhere ... I'll end the spell once the gate is open.
string: 太棒了！记住要一直往前走，直到找到那个开关。它就在……某个地方……等门一开我就解除法术。

original: Now stand still while I cast this, it might tingle ... slightly.
string: 现在站着别动，我要施法了，可能会有……一点点疼。

original: You've done it, excellent work!
Well, it seems like your mind is still in one piece. That's good. Seems like it went better than the last time.
string: 嗯，看来你的脑子还完好无损。那就好。看起来这次比上一次顺利多了。

original: With this I can finally finish my research. I couldn't have done it without your assistance, I'm exceptionately grateful.
string: 有了这次的成果，我终于可以完成我的研究了。没有你的帮助，我不可能做到这些。我对你感激不尽。

original: How long until you complete your research?
string: 你还要多久才能完成你那研究？

original: Hmm? Oh, not for another ten or twenty years at the very least. I'm still having a myriad of problems to account for, after all.
string: 嗯？哦，至少还得十到二十年吧。毕竟还有数不清的问题要解决呢。

original: But enough about the details. You have a dragon to hunt, remember?
string: 不过还是别再深究这个了。你还有条龙要屠呢，不是吗？

original: I don't have much in the way of weaponry to help you, but feel free to take whatever supplies you need from my laboratory.
string: 我没有太多武器可以帮上你，但你可以随意从我的实验室带走你需要的任何补给。

original: You've helped me with the most difficult part of my research today, and for that I thank you.
string: 你今天帮我完成了研究中最困难的部分，为此我衷心感谢你。

original: I may join up with you later on once I've cleaned myself up. Transferring minds from one body to another really works up a sweat!
string: 等我把自己收拾干净后，也许会在晚些时候加入你们。把意识从一个身体转移到另一个身体真的会让人出一身汗！

original: I'll be heading back to town to help coordinate the rescue. I'm not much of a fighter so I'm afraid I'll just get in your way down here.
string: 我要回城里去协调救援行动了。我不是一个战士，留在这里恐怕只会给你们添麻烦。

original: Remember, that dragon has likely lured us here for a reason, so be careful. I don't know what you can expect to find when you reach its lair.
string: 记住，那条龙把你引到这里来一定是有原因的，所以小心行事。我也不敢断言当你抵达它的巢穴时会遇到什么。

original: Best of luck, Dragonborn, and godspeed.
string: 祝你好运，龙裔。愿众神保佑你一路顺风。

original: Better to stick together down here. Keep your eyes peeled for traps.
string: 在这下面我们最好还是结伴而行。注意周围，小心陷阱。

original: We're getting close, I feel it. Stay focused, there may be trouble ahead.
string: 我们快接近目标了，我能感觉到。保持警觉，前方可能会有危险。

original: Look at these carvings. This place must be ancient. I doubt any of us can read the writings on these walls.
string: 看看这些雕刻。这个地方一定非常古老。我估计我们之中没人能读懂墙上的文字。

original: Be on guard. The dangers of this dungeon are well known among my peers.
string: 提高警惕。这个地下城的危险在我们这行的圈子里是出了名的。

original: Some say the dwemer's disappearance is related to the Heart of Lorkhan. But that's for scholars, not adventurers such as we. Stay focused.
string: 有些人说锻莫们的消失与洛克汗之心有关。但这是学者们的课题，和我们这种冒险者无关。还是继续专注于任务吧。

original: Gods, I've never seen such a thing! Did the dwemer build all this? They disappeared long ago, but nobody has since been able to work out why.
string: 天哪，我从未见过这样的东西！这些都是锻莫建造的吗？他们早就消失了，但至今没人搞清楚他们为何会消失。

original: I'll keep my eyes peeled for your sister.
string: 我会留意你妹妹的下落的。

original: I wonder what dwemer taste like...
string: 我在想锻莫尝起来是什么味道……

original: Tiraaz Tiid Tinvaak. Much time has passed since last we spoke. Dukaan, for a time I feared you would not honor my challenge.
string: Tiraaz Tiid Tinvaak（很久不见了）。自我们上次对话以来，已经过去很久了。Dukaan（丢人的东西），有那么一段时间，我都以为你不会接受我的挑战。

original: Explain yourself, dragon. Why have you lured us here?
string: 解释一下吧，龙。为什么你要把我们引到这儿来？

original: It is simple, Dovahkiin. Aav Rovaan Dilon, I invited you to join my wandering dead in this ... Brom Lok Strunmah, it is my seat of power.
string: 很简单，都瓦克因。Aav Rovaan Dilon（加入死灵的漫步），我邀请你加入我这儿的死亡大军……Brom Lok Strunmah（北方的天空与大地），这里是我的权力中心。

original: Nuz Krosis, now that you are here, the prey is scattered and weak.
string: Nuz Krosis（但是很遗憾），现在你已经来到这儿了，猎物已经被分散，而且也已经很虚弱了。

original: You shall fall and become one of my Lahvu Dilon Slen, my army of rotting flesh.
string: 你将倒下，并且加入我的 Lahvu Dilon Slen（行尸走肉大军），我的行尸走肉大军。

original: Do not think I will fall so easily, dragon.
string: 别以为我会那么容易倒下，龙。

original: I have many who will answer my call but you are Motmahus and indeed I will be expecting you.
string: 有很多人会响应我的召唤，但你是个 Motmahus（棘手的家伙），我确实对你寄予厚望。

original: Togaat Lahney. Follow if you can so that I may swallow you in the fury of the north wind.
string: Togaat Lahney（试着活下来吧）。如果你能跟上来，我将用北风之怒吞噬你。

original: Why are you trying to raise an undead army?
string: 你为什么要召集亡灵大军？

original: Daal Moro Bok Dovah. To restore the age of the dragons, I must turn the filth against itself.
string: Daal Moro Bok Dovah（光复龙的荣耀时代）。为了恢复龙的时代，我必须让污秽之物自相残杀。

original: I invite the strongest of Taazokaan to become my Sahrot Tu Qahnaar, so that we may begin the hunt. Prodah Tir Vokun.
string: 我要邀请 Taazokaan（泰姆瑞尔）上的最强者来作为我的 Sahrot Tu Qahnaar（强大仆从），这样我们就可以开始狩猎。Prodah Tir Vokun（宣告它的来临）。

original: It's raising the dead! We need to find some place to hide!
string: 它在让死者复生！我们得找个地方藏起来！

original: This way! Up towards the platform over there! Hurry!
string: 往这走！到这个平台上去！快！

original: Oh thank the gods you're alive.
Unfortunately I have dire news. As you were down there stirring the hornet's nest, the Empire sent another contingent to do things their way.
string: 不幸的是，我有个坏消息要告诉你。当你在下面捅马蜂窝的时候，帝国派出了另一支队伍，想要按他们的方式来处理这件事。

original: I guess the Empire was starting to feel some pain in their purses due to the suspended trade routes. Funny, how coin can move mountains sometimes.
string: 我想帝国是因为贸易路线中断而开始感到财务上的压力了。有时候金钱确实能推动大山呢。

original: You sound concerned about something.
string: 你听起来似乎有什么担忧？

original: That I am, I was hoping to involve as few people as necessary.
string: 确实如此。我希望牵扯进来的人越少越好。

original: And what of its trap? Were you able to find out what the dragon was planning?
string: 那么它的圈套是什么？你查出那条龙到底打算做什么了吗？

original: It aims to raise an army of fallen warriors to storm Tamriel.
string: 它打算召集一支由阵亡战士组成的不死军团来进攻泰姆瑞尔。

original: Gods, then it sounds like that dragon is getting everything it ever wished for today. Now it has what it needs, an army at its doorstep.
string: 诸神在上，看来这条龙今天就能如愿以偿了。现在它已经有了它所需要的一切——一支送到家门口来的大军。

original: We need to put an end to this as soon as possible, before it has the chance to turn the imperial legion soldiers against us.
string: 我们得尽快了结此事，赶在它将帝国军团士兵转换成不死军团来对付我们之前。

original: I fear you're the only one who can do this. Legion soldiers aren't trained to fight dragons. It's up to you now, Dragonborn, let's go!
string: 我恐怕你是唯一能做到的人了。帝国士兵没有接受过与龙战斗的训练，现在全靠你了，龙裔。我们走！

original: Is... is it dead? Is it finally over?
string: 它……它死了吗？终于结束了吗？

original: The dragon is dead.
I ... I can hardly believe it. We've finally done it then. It's over.
string: 我……我简直不敢相信。我们做到了。一切都结束了。

original: By Zenithar, you really are Dragonborn.
string: 泽尼萨尔在上，你真不愧是龙裔。

original: Well, I guess the next great challenge will be getting this town back on its feet.
string: 嗯，我想接下来最大的挑战，就是让这个小镇重新恢复生机了。

original: At least with a legion of imperial soldiers here, we should be able to get that done much quicker than I would've expected.
string: 至少现在有帝国军团驻扎在这里，重建的速度应该会比我预想的快得多。

original: Once the houses are rebuilt, we'll need to bring over new miners and get the mines back up and running again.
string: 一旦完成房屋的重建，我们就需要招募新的矿工让矿井重新运转起来。

original: But that's my battle to fight, Dragonborn, not yours. You've done us justice this day, mark my words.
string: 但那就是我的任务了，龙裔，你的任务已经结束了。你今天为我们伸张了正义，记住我的话。

original: And don't worry, I haven't forgotten about the bounty on that dragon. Here, 10,000 gold. You've earned it and my gratitude.
string: 以及，别担心，我可没忘记那条龙的悬赏金。给，10000金币。这是你应得的，我很感激你。

original: I guess this will have to do.
Don't be too ungrateful now, kingdoms past have toppled for lesser sums of gold.
string: 别太不领情啊，历史上有不少王国就毁在“没钱”这俩字上。

original: I was glad to be able to help.
The Red Wave should be sailing back to Skyrim soon, should you wish to return to the mainland.
string: 如果你想返回大陆，赤红波浪号应该很快就会返回天际

original: But with what happened here at Stonehollow, likely there are still people around the island in need of help.
string: 但是考虑到巨石空谷发生的一切，岛上很可能还有其他人需要帮助。

original: Do visit us again in the near future. Once we start to rebuild, there may be people here in need of a competent adventurer such as yourself.
string: 如果在不久的将来你能再次造访我们，那就太好了。一旦重建开始，这里肯定会有一些人需要像你这样出色的冒险者。

original: Once again, thank you, Dragonborn, for the help. An act like this won't so easily be forgotten.
string: 以及，我得再一次感谢你，龙裔。这样的恩情，是不会被轻易遗忘的。

original: How is the rebuild coming along?
string: 重建工作进行得怎样了？

original: We've got our work cut out for us. Right now we need to work towards burying the dead and clearing all this rubble.
string: 我们还有很多事要做。目前的首要任务是安葬死者，并清理所有这些废墟。

original: Once we have that taken care of, we can begin rebuilding the houses that were demolished by the dragon, including the local inn.
string: 等这些都干完了，我们才能开始重建那些被龙摧毁的房子，包括本地的旅店。

original: We've managed to clear the rubble. Having a contingent of imperial soliders to spare certainly helped to expedite the process.
string: 我们已经清理完了废墟。能有一队帝国士兵抽空来帮忙，确实大大加快了进度。

original: Now work can begin on restoring the houses and getting that mine reopened.
string: 现在么，可以着手重建房屋，重新开放矿场了。

original: Speak to that Khajiit merchant if you have anything to trade. Gods know we could use all the help we can get right now.
string: 如果有什么东西要交易的话可以去找那个卡吉特人。我们现在得团结一切可以团结的力量啊。

original: The inn has been rebuilt and is under new management. Seems like things are starting to turn around here in Stonehollow.
string: 旅店已经重建完毕，并由新东家接手经营。看来巨石空谷的状况已经逐渐开始好转了。

original: We're also starting to see a few new faces turn up. Good that news of the dragon attack didn't permanently turn people away.
string: 我们也开始看到一些新面孔出现。看来龙袭的事并没有让人们彻底对这里望而却步。

original: Most of the damage has been repaired, the mines have reopened, and ore shipments have resumed. So it's back to business as usual.
string: 大部分损坏已得到修复，矿山已重新开放，矿石运输也已恢复。一切终于回到了正轨。

original: Can you tell me about the old abandoned fort south of the docks?
string: 你能跟我讲讲港口南边的那个废弃堡垒吗？

original: Ah yes, Fort Valus. An old imperial fort constructed to deter marauders approaching from the south.
string: 啊，那是瓦鲁斯堡。一座古老的帝国堡垒，旨在震慑从南方入侵的掠夺者。

original: But ever since Fort Moonwatch was constructed, and the Empire began neglecting mining operations here, it fell into disrepair.
string: 但自从观月堡落成，加上帝国开始疏于管理这里的采矿业，这座堡垒也就逐渐被荒废了。

original: I suppose if it wasn't for the ill rumours surrounding the place, the marauders themselves would've overrun it by now.
string: 我想要不是因为这个地方流传着种种不祥传闻，恐怕掠夺者早就把它占领了。

original: We'll talk about it once that dragon is defeated.
string: 等我们打败那条龙以后再来讨论它吧。

original: What are the rumours?
Oh, it's just nonsense really. Some say witches use it for necromantic practices, but legion scouts have been unable to find anything.
string: 哦，都是一些无稽之谈罢了。有人声称有女巫在那里进行死灵法术活动，但军团斥候一直没有找到任何证据。

original: Listen, with the mines re-opening, I'd sleep much sounder knowing that fort won't fall into the hands of some unsavory bunch.
string: 听着，现在矿场重新开工了，如果能确保那座堡垒不会落入某些不怀好意的人手中，我也会睡得安稳许多。
