string: 我已经叫你滚了！我不想再看到你！

original: Did I not say I that I do not wish to see your face again?! Get out of here!
string: 我不是说过我不想再见到你的脸吗？！快滚！

original: Begone, you filthy curr.
string: 滚开，你这个肮脏的混蛋。

original: By Ysmir, if I could move my arms I'd strangle you for betraying me!
string: 伊斯米尔在上，如果我的手还能动，我一定亲手掐死你这个叛徒！

original: May Talos strike you down, curr!
Remove yourself from my presence! Begone!
Careful around that witch, friend. Don't let her words lull you into a false sense of security.
string: 小心那个女巫，朋友。别让她的话使你放松警惕。

original: Good luck finding that witch. Remember, there's a boat you can use at the farmstead just west of Stonehollow.
string: 祝你能找到那个女巫。记住，在巨石空谷西边的农场那儿有一艘船可以用。

original: The sooner you can find my pants and an antidote for my condition, the sooner I can put this predicament behind me.
string: 你越早找到我的裤子和解药，我就能越早脱困。

original: Please, make haste. I fear what may happen if a pack of wolves pick up my scent while I am unable to defend myself.
string: 请快点吧。我担心在我无力自卫的时候，会有一群狼嗅到了我的气味……。

original: Thank you so much for helping me out. Words barely do justice to show how truly grateful I am for what you've done.
string: 非常感谢你的帮助。任何语言都无法表达我对你的感激之情。

original: May Talos keep you safe on the roads.
string: 愿塔洛斯保佑你一路平安。

original: Talos bless you, my friend.
string: 塔洛斯祝福你，我的朋友

original: If you hadn't found me when you did, I might've been meat for the wolves by now.
string: 如果你当时没及时找到我，我可能已经被狼吃掉了。

original: I need some help over here!
Help! I... I can't move!
Please, you must end my torment! I beg you!
string: 求你了，结束我的痛苦吧！我求求你了！

original: Don't let me die a slow and painful death! You have to kill me!
string: 别让我慢慢地痛苦地死去！你必须杀了我！

original: Put me out of this misery! Do it now!
string: 让我从痛苦中解脱吧！就现在！

original: Don't walk away! I... I can't live like this any longer!
string: 别走！我……我不能再这样活下去了！

original: What happened here?
We were caught by surprise by a dragon, of all things. This one heard rumors about dragons returning to Tamriel but did not believe it to be true.
string: 我们居然遭遇了一条龙的袭击，真是做梦也没想到。我是有听说巨龙又回到了泰姆瑞尔大陆，但一直都没当真过。

original: The local guard didn't stand a chance against the monster and the settlement was quickly engulfed in flames.
string: 当地的卫兵根本不是那怪物的对手，整个定居点转眼就被火焰吞噬了。

original: The lucky ones managed to escape into the wilderness, but most were eaten or burned to cinders. It is not a good way to leave this world.
string: 有些幸运的人逃进了荒野，但大多数人要么被吃掉，要么就是被烧成了灰烬。这可不是什么离世的好方式。

original: Through the smoke this one could see it return to the mountains across the steampools from where it came. Perhaps that is where it is roosting?
string: 透过烟雾，我看见它往蒸汽池方向的山上飞走了。或许那就是它的藏身地？

original: If you would seek it out and put it to the sword, speak to Ja'Shavi-Dar first. He has equipment for sale that you may find useful.
string: 如果你想去找到它，并把它钉死在剑下，请先跟加'撒维-达聊聊吧。他那儿有在卖一些你可能会用得上的装备。

original: What do you do here?
This one keeps an eye on the customers. If you need to trade, speak to Ja'Shavi-Dar.
string: 我就是个看场子的。如果你有东西要买卖的话，去找加'撒维-达吧。

original: Why come to this island?
That decision was not mine. Ja'Shavi-Dar goes where there is profit to be made and on an island like this there is much profit to be made.
string: 这不是我的主意。加'撒维-达去哪赚钱，我们就去哪。而在这种岛上，能赚的钱可不少。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
It is a cold place and the people that work here are colder. Still, this one holds to her duties no matter where the road takes us.
string: 这鬼地方很冷，而在这儿工作的人们更“冷”。但，无论路把我们带往何方，我们始终尽心尽职。

original: One day though, I hope that road takes us back to the warm sands of Elsweyr.
string: 希望总有一天，前路能把我们带回艾斯维尔的温暖沙地。

original: Do you need any help?
This one will manage, though it is a surprise we even survived at all.
string: 我自己能应付，不过我们还能活下来，也算是个奇迹了。

original: A place like this cannot hold against a dragon, moreso now than before the empire started cutting resources.
string: 像这样的地方根本抵挡不住一条龙，在帝国削减资源投入之后就更是如此了。

original: Each year the empire sends less and less soldiers to defend the mining settlement, and now look what happens.
string: 每一年帝国派来保卫定居点的士兵都在减少，现在你看，出事了吧。

original: But do not worry about this one, worry about those who fled into the forests and have yet to return.
string: 不过别为在下担心了，还是担心下那些逃进森林却再也没回来的那些人吧。

original: If the dragon did not eat them, surely the things that crawl in the wilderness will.
string: 哪怕那条龙没把他们吃掉，他们也很有可能被荒野中的那些野兽给生吞了。

original: What do you do here?
This one manages the coin. Speak to my husband Ja'Shavi-Dar if you're looking to make a purchase.
string: 我负责掌管帐目。如果要买东西的话，请找我的丈夫加'撒维-达。

original: He sells all manner of arms and armor for adventurers heading to the barrow.
string: 他专为前往古坟冒险的冒险者们出售各式各样的武器和装备。

original: Lately business has been good; it is unusual to see so many adventurers come to the island.
string: 到现在为止生意还不错，毕竟能有这么多冒险者跑来这座岛上，实属罕见。

original: Why come to this island?
Indeed, sometimes this one asks that very same question.
string: 说实话，有时我自己也会问这个问题。

original: There may be coin to be made from the adventurers seeking glory and fortune in the barrow, but there is coin to be found in warmer climates, no?
string: 诚然，从那些寻求荣耀与财富的冒险者身上是能赚到些钱，但在更温暖的地方难道就赚不到钱了吗？

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
It is a place we'd sooner put behind us were it for the climate alone. Still, there is good coin to be made here.
string: 若单论气候，这地方我们巴不得能早日将其抛诸脑后。不过在这里确实能赚到不少钱。

original: What are you selling?
The tools of the trade for many an adventurer. Take a look.
string: 为冒险者们所准备的各类工具。来看看吧。

original: When did this happen?
string: 这件事是什么时候发生的？

original: Not long ago, just before the sun began to rise. The dragon burned the town and scattered its folks before returning to the mountains.
string: 也没过多久，就在日出之前。那条龙焚毁了镇子，把居民赶跑后又飞回了山里。

original: This one thinks it may have been a calculated attack.
string: 在下认为这是一场有计划的袭击。

original: Why come to this island?
Business is good here. Many adventurers come by seeking to test their mettle in the barrow on the eastern side of the island.
string: 这里的生意不错。许多冒险者都会来这儿，去岛东边那座古坟里一试身手。

original: This one provides them the means of keeping themselves alive in such a dangerous place. It is a good relationship, yes?
string: 而在下，就给他们提供能让他们在那种危险的地方保住小命的装备。算是互帮互助，不是吗？

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
It is a curious thing. Why would anyone want to come to such an unwelcoming land? But the fact is many adventurers do.
string: 这确实挺奇怪的，怎么会有人想来这种荒凉的地方呢？但实际上跑来的冒险者确实不少。

original: And in the footsteps of those adventurers, gold surely follows.
string: 而跟着这些冒险者的脚步，金币自然也就随之而来了。

original: What's with those big mushrooms?
string: 那些巨大的蘑菇是什么？

original: They call them emperor parasol. They started growing here following the Red Year so they likely came from Morrowind.
string: 人们叫它帝王伞。是从红年之后开始在这里生长的，所以大概是从晨风飘过来的吧。

original: What do you do here?
I work the mines, my brother works the farm. I can't speak for the others; I've never seen them work.
string: 我负责在矿上干活，我的兄弟负责种田。至于其他人，我也不知道，我都没见他们工作过。

original: I used to travel Cyrodiil with a theatre troupe, that is, before my fellow performers were brutally murdered by bandits on the road.
string: 我以前曾经跟着一个剧团在希罗帝尔巡回演出，直到我的同伴们在半路上被强盗残忍杀害为止。

original: It seems Cyrodiil isn't the place of order it was once known to be. Honest work is getting harder to find on the mainland which led me here.
string: 看来希罗帝尔已不像过去那样井然有序了。在大陆上找份正经工作越来越难，所以我就来到了这里。

original: With the coin I make I hope one day to form a new theatre group and begin traveling the lands once more.
string: 等我赚够了钱，我希望能重新组建一个剧团，再次踏上旅途。

original: Now, if you don't mind...
string: 好了，如果你不介意的话……

original: Why do they call you 'Speaks-Many-Tongues'
string: 为什么他们叫你“通晓万言”？

original: *sigh* Fine, allow me to give you a demonstration...
string: *叹息* 好吧，跟我来，我给你演示一下……

original: I must admit, I'm a bit rusty.
string: 我得承认，我的技艺现在有点生疏了。

original: That was amazing!
Thank you. Now leave me be.
string: 谢谢。现在请让我安静一会儿。

original: That was terrible.
Perhaps the muck on your boots is also in your ears.
string: 也许你鞋底的泥巴也堵住了你的耳朵吧。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
What do I look like to you? A tour guide? You've got legs, go out there and see it for yourself instead of wasting my time with worthless banter.
string: 我看起来像导游吗？你有腿，自己出去看看，别用这种无聊的废话来浪费我的时间。

original: What do you do here?
I grow the ingredients the cooks use so that ungrateful fools such as yourself can enjoy a meal. A simple thank you would suffice.
string: 我种植厨师们做菜所需的原料，好让像你这种不知感恩的家伙也能吃上一顿饭。说一句简单的“谢谢”就够了。

original: Tell me your story.
I was living peacefully until I ran into an annoying sort who wouldn't stop asking me questions.
string: 直到有个吵闹的家伙跑过来不停地向我问问题之前，我的生活还挺平静的。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
It's cold.
Why do they call you 'Plants-Bitter-Seeds'?
string: 为什么他们叫你“种下苦种”?

original: Keep asking me these useless questions and you'll soon find out.
string: 继续问我这些无聊的问题，你就会知道原因了。

original: Tell me about yourself.
I keep the mining settlement supplied with fresh lumber. Tis easier than working the mines I assure you.
string: 我负责给采矿定居点供应新鲜木材。我跟你讲，这可比挖矿轻松多了。

original: Yngfa and I work the mill here and offer work to anyone looking to make some good, honest coin.
string: 我和瑛法经营锯木厂，也为任何想赚点正当、诚实金币的人提供工作。

original: I work the mill here and offer work to anyone looking to make some good, honest coin.
string: 我在这里经营锯木厂，也为任何想赚点正当、诚实金币的人提供工作。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
Not the friendliest place, I'll give you that. But it's sure better than being chased out of house and home by bandits and cut-throats.
string: 我承认，这地方确实不太友好，但总比被强盗和杀人犯赶出家门强多了。

original: Moved here with Yngfa from Skyrim years ago. Heard there was ample work to be had here and the rumors proved true.
string: 我和瑛法是几年前从天际搬来的。听说这里有很多工作机会，事实也确实如此。

original: What are your thoughts on the civil war?
I couldn't care less about the civil war. All that bloodshed over what? A true nord never puts his own brothers and sisters to the sword.
string: 我才不在乎什么内战。打得头破血流究竟图的是什么？一个真正的诺德人是绝不会亲手杀害自己的兄弟姐妹的。

original: Tell me about yourself.
I work the mill with my husband, Balmir. It's tough work, but we earn honest coin.
string: 我和我的丈夫鲍米尔一起经营着这座锯木厂。这工作挺艰苦的，但每分钱都来得干干净净。

original: We don't get many visitors. Most adventurers head straight for that barrow on the other side of the island.
string: 我们这儿没有什么访客。大多数冒险者都直接奔向岛另一边的古坟去了。

original: I came to this island with my husband, Balmir. With his passing, the responsibility of running this mill is now in my hands.
string: 我和我丈夫鲍米尔一起来到这个岛上。他去世后，经营这个锯木厂的责任就落在了我的肩上。

original: There are people that depend on my lumber. It's tough work, but it's an honest living.
string: 人们就指着我的木材了。虽然工作很辛苦，但这是一份诚实的工作。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
It can be a dangerous place. At least the marauders, warlocks and vampires keep each other busy most of the time.
string: 这里有时很危险。但好在大多数时候，掠夺者、巫师和吸血鬼之间都是在互相打斗。

original: We get the occasional troublemaker, but the East Empire Company was kind enough to assign guards to watch over the mill.
string: 我们也偶尔会碰到麻烦，但东帝国公司还是挺厚道地给我们安排了卫兵。

original: What are your thoughts on the civil war?
While I don't support imperial bootlicking I also don't believe what Ulfric stands for is true and just.
string: 我既不赞同卖国的帝国，也不相信乌弗瑞克代表的是大义。

original: He's just another fool vying for the throne. It won't end well for him even if he does become High King.
string: 他不过是另一个觊觎王位的蠢货罢了。即使他真当上了至高王，下场也不会好到哪去。

original: We're a bit insulated from those troubles here, but war knows no bounds. I only hope the conflict is resolved before it spreads even further.
string: 我们这里离战乱还算比较远，但是战争一直在扩大，我只希望冲突能在蔓延开来前结束。

original: We recently heard word from the mainland that the Imperials finally surrendered to Ulfric Stormcloak and his forces.
string: 我们最近从大陆那边听到消息，说帝国终于要向乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷和他的军队投降了。

original: But I fear his victory will only serve to isolate Skyrim from the rest of Tamriel.
string: 但我担心他的胜利只会让天际与泰姆瑞尔大陆的其他地区更加隔绝。

original: We recently heard word from the mainland that the Stormcloaks finally surrendered to General Tullius and his forces.
string: 我们最近从大陆那边听到消息，说风暴斗篷终于向图留斯将军和他的军队投降了。

original: But I fear this victory only gives the Thalmor free reign to abolish all Talos worship across Skyrim.
string: 但我担心这次胜利只会让梭默得以肆意废除天际各地对塔洛斯的崇拜。

original: What do you do here?
I tend the hall of the dead. Many miners come to this island seeking their fortune and many of them end up dead.
string: 我管理着亡者之厅。许多矿工来到这座岛寻找财富，然而最后却在这里丢了性命。

original: That makes me a busy man.
string: 这也让我变得非常忙碌。

original: Occasionally I wander the roads, wherever Arkay bids me.
string: 我偶尔也会好奇，阿尔凯究竟要把我引向何方。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
It's a cold and unforgiving place. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone aside from those who do the work of Arkay.
string: 这是一个寒冷且无情的地方。除了那些为阿尔凯效力的人之外，我都不建议别人来这里。

original: It draws all the wrong sorts. I should know; I once served as a healer for a party looking to explore that dungeon.
string: 它吸引的都是些不该来的人。我很清楚这点，因为我曾为一支探索地下城的队伍担任治疗师。

original: Adventurers treat it as a rite of passage; those who survive it are regarded highly in adventuring circles and rightly so.
string: 冒险者们把它当作一种试炼；能活着出来的人，会得到冒险圈子里的人们的认可和颂扬。

original: Bandits on the other hand continue to pillage through its ruins every day, hoping adventurers make its deeper chambers more accessible.
string: 而强盗们则天天在遗迹里反复扫荡，希望冒险者们能让遗迹的深处变得更容易进入。

original: Can you cure me of vampirism?
string: 你能治好我的吸血鬼病吗？

original: No, but I know of someone who can. Last I knew he was staying in Morthal. Falion, if I recall correctly. Seek him out.
string: 我治不好。不过我知道有个叫法利昂的人能治。如果没记错的话，上次听说他住在莫萨尔，你去找他吧。

original: Can you cure me of lycanthropy?
string: 你能治好我的化狼症吗？

original: I have little knowledge of Hircine's curse, save that those afflicted often lose control. No, I am afraid I cannot help you there.
string: 我对海尔辛的诅咒不怎么了解，只知道被诅咒的人常常会失去理智。抱歉，我帮不了你。

original: What do you do here?
I work the forge and provide arms and armor to the local guards and any adventurers that stop by on their way to the barrow.
string: 我在铁匠铺工作，为本地卫兵和途经此地前往古坟的冒险者提供武器与护甲。

original: All I can say is, business has been pretty good lately. That is, until that damned dragon attacked.
string: 我得说，最近的生意还不错，至少在那头该死的龙袭击了镇子之前还不错。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
Before outsiders showed up and started digging here, this island used to belong to the nords.
string: 在外来者涌入这座岛并且开始在岛上到处采掘之前，这座岛属于诺德人。

original: Those who didn't fall to the marauders joined them. All that's left of that old culture now is the barrow on the other side of the island.
string: 那些没有被掠夺者杀死的人都加入了他们。如今古代诺德文化的最后遗存就只剩下岛另一端的那座古坟了。

original: Some say it used to be a city. Nothing but ruins now.
string: 有人说那里本来是座城市，但现在也就只剩断壁残垣了。

original: What are your thoughts on the civil war?
You might as well ask me about the rebellion in Hammerfell. The troubles of Skyrim bother me not.
string: 你还不如问问我关于落锤省的反抗运动呢。天际省的事情我不关心。

original: What do you do here?
I work the fields with the Argonians. Can't say I've ever heard of an Argonian coming this far north, but who am I to judge?
string: 我和阿尔贡人一起在这片土地上耕作。我以前从没听说过有阿尔贡人会跑到这么北边的地方来，不过我又有什么资格去评判呢？

original: All I wish is to make enough coin here to give my daughter the life she deserves. My husband, Hulgard, seems to like it here well enough though.
string: 我最大的愿望就是能攒够钱，让我的女儿能过上她应得的生活。但我的丈夫，霍尔格德，似乎对这个地方已经很满意了。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
It's not a very good place to raise a child. Not that the mainland is much better off right now with the civil war, but it's better than here.
string: 这里并不适合孩子的成长。尽管大陆那边正在打内战，但也总比这里要好。

original: Seems like the only lands free of conflict are those that are completely inhospitable.
string: 看来只有那些人迹罕至不适合居住的地方才不会被冲突给波及。

original: It's not a very good place to raise a child. Now that the civil war has ended, we should be thinking about returning to Skyrim.
string: 这里并不适合孩子的成长。既然内战已经结束，我们也该考虑回天际了。

original: But my husband is a stubborn one and wants to see his business succeed here on this cold, wretched island.
string: 可我那丈夫是个死脑筋，非要在这座寒冷又凄苦的岛上把生意做大。

original: What are your thoughts on the civil war?
I'll be happy as long as it doesn't follow us here. We've seen enough bloodshed in recent months to last a lifetime.
string: 只要战火别烧到我们这儿来，我就心满意足了。最近这几个月里，我们见过的血腥惨剧已经够我们记一辈子的了。

original: As if working in the mines wasn't hard enough already, that damned dragon just had to come and make things a heck of a lot worse.
string: 在矿上工作已经够辛苦的了，那条该死的龙偏偏还要来添乱，把事情弄得更糟。

original: I'm glad it finally ended. We've seen enough bloodshed in recent months to last a lifetime.
string: 我很高兴这一切终于结束了。最近这几个月里，我们见过的血腥惨剧已经够我们记一辈子的了。

original: What do you do here?
I just started working the mines here. Transferred in from Hammerfell with my sisters Leone and Lalaine.
string: 我才刚开始在矿里工作。我和我的姐妹里欧妮和拉莱恩刚从落锤搬过来。

original: Heard there was good coin to be made here, I'm beginning to think I was mistaken.
string: 我听说这里能赚大钱，但现在我开始怀疑是不是搞错了。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
Not sure what I can say, really. I'm new to this place myself. Truth be told, I never even knew it existed until recently.
string: 我也说不上来什么。我自己也是刚搬过来的。说实话，我之前根本不知道有这么一个岛，直到最近才知道。

original: What do you do here?
That's none of your business. Keep walking.
Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
The mead is bad, the air is cold, and coin is few and far between. Does that answer your question?
string: 蜜酒难喝，空气冰冷，钱还少。这回答你满意了吗？

original: What do you do here?
I mine. The question is; what do YOU do here?
string: 我挖矿。而问题是……*你*在这里做什么？

original: Yes, I heard you 'saved' the town from that dragon. But honestly, the imperials sent a full contingent to put the beast to the sword.
string: 是的，我听说你“救”了这个镇子免受龙灾。但老实说，帝国派了一整队士兵来杀那条龙。

original: That problem would've been solved without your intervention. And now look at us; stuck with a gloating 'hero'.
string: 就算你不出手，他们也能搞定的。现在倒好，我们还得忍受一个自鸣得意的“英雄”。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
*sigh* Look, I only just moved here with my brother and sister. I don't know anything about this place aside from the mine.
string: *叹息* 你看，我和我的兄弟姐妹刚搬到这儿来。矿场以外的事情我一概不知。

original: If you're here to work, grab a pickaxe and get to it. Otherwise just leave us be.
string: 如果你是来工作的，那拿起鹤嘴锄挖就是了。如果不是，那请走开。

original: What do you do here?
So there I was, admiring myself in the mirror when I thought: Where on Nirn are my stunningly good looks needed the most?
string: 哦我么，在赞美镜中的自己的时候我总会想，在整个奈恩上，最需要我这绝美无双样貌的地方是哪里呢？

original: Naturally my thoughts came to rest upon the bleakest land in all of Tamriel. Wyrmstooth!
string: 然后我自然就想到了整个泰姆瑞尔中最最阴郁的地方——龙牙岛！

original: So with that in mind I packed up my bags and made the perilous voyage to this remote mining village and enlisted in the mines.
string: 于是我收拾行囊，战胜风浪历尽千险来到这个因采矿业而兴起的小村庄，加入到挖矿的队伍中去了。

original: Why, you should've seen the look on Lurius' face. I was a beacon of light for that poor soul stumbling alone in the dark.
string: 至于为什么，你看看卢里乌斯的表情就知道了。我就像一盏明灯，照亮了那个在黑暗中独自蹒跚而行的可怜灵魂。

original: Much like the look on your face as we speak. Marvelous, aren't I?
string: 就像此刻你脸上流露出的神情一样。我真是太了不起了，不是吗？

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
I'd love to tell you more, but I'm new to this place myself. Maybe Gildan can tell you more; she does like to fixate on boring details.
string: 我很乐意跟你聊聊，但我也是新来的。或许吉尔丹能跟你详细讲讲，她还挺喜欢纠结那些无趣的细节的。

original: Me? I am a man of nature. A man of the heart and of the soul. But more specifically, the face.
string: 至于我？我是一个热爱自然的人。一个有心有灵的人。更确切地说，是个靠脸吃饭的人。

original: Is there something I can help you with?
There most certainly is something you can help me with. I am amazed by your proactive approach!
string: 当然有事情能让你帮忙。你的积极主动让我感到惊讶！

original: You see, I'm in a bind. My face is so glorious to behold, too glorious for this quaint mining village alone.
string: 你看，我现在有点犯难。我的脸蛋是如此光彩夺目，在这整个村庄里都显得太过于耀眼了。

original: I need someone to go out there into the unforgiving wilderness and spread the word of my divine physique.
string: 我需要有人去到那无情的荒野，传播我神圣体质的传说。

original: ...well? Shouldn't you be writing this into your journal?
string: ……怎么？你不该拿笔把这些记下来吗？

original: ... You're... just standing there. But I understand how awestruck you must be by my presence.
string: ……你……就在那儿傻站着。但我明白你一定被我的存在惊艳到了。

original: Maybe another time.
Fine. I'll be here waiting for you to return to my splendid, glorious bosom.
string: 好的。我会在这里等你回到我这美妙绝伦的怀抱。

original: And if you see Bazrob, tell him my nipples are far more glorious than his.
string: 还有，如果你遇上巴卓布的话，告诉他我的乳头可比他的漂亮多了。

original: What do you do here?
I do what I can to convince people not to kill my husband. He can be a bit much at times, I know, but I do love him.
string: 我的工作就是竭尽所能劝说大家别拿刀砍了我丈夫。他确实过分了一些，但我还爱着他。

original: I have no idea why though, I'm beginning to think I may have been cursed by a warlock.
string: 我也不知道这是为什么，我开始怀疑自己是不是被某个术士下了咒。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
I don't know what else to say, really. I only just moved here myself. I've heard rumors about this place, seems like they were true.
string: 说实话，我也不知道还能说什么。我自己也才刚搬到这里。我曾听说过关于这个地方的一些传闻，看来都是真的。

original: What do you have for sale?
Food for the hungry! Drinks for the thirsty!
string: 饿了有美食！渴了有美酒！

original: Do you have a room available?
I do. It's yours for ten gold. What say you?
string: 有的，付上10个金币，那房间就是你的了。怎么样？

original: Remember that time a few moments ago when I showed you to your room?
string: 几秒钟前我才带你看过房间呢，还记得吗？

original: Sure.
Great, right this way. If you need anything just shout it out.
string: 好极了，请往这边走。需要什么的话只管吼我就是啦。

original: And by shout, I don't mean, you know...
string: 不过我说的吼，可不是指那种……你知道的……

original: What do you do here?
You dense? What does it look like I do?
string: 你脑子坏了？你看我像做啥的？

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
Well, you're asking the wrong innkeeper there. I'll wager the previous innkeeper had a few good stories to share.
string: 好吧，你可问错人了。我敢打赌前任掌柜肯定有不少精彩故事可以分享。

original: Sadly he died in dragon fire.
Why is the inn called The Handsome Hermit?
string: 为什么这家旅店叫“俏隐士”？

original: That's for me to know and for you to find out.
string: 我知道但不告诉你，你自己去找答案吧

original: What do you do here?
I keep this place from falling into disarray, which would be a shame given that it was recently rebuilt.
string: 我的工作是让这里始终一尘不染，作为一个刚重建起来的地方，太脏乱可就丢脸了。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
My advice? Get out there and explore it for yourself. It's a big island, bigger than folks give it credit for.
string: 我的建议？去四处亲自探索一下吧。这是一个很大的岛，比人们想象的要大。

original: Heard some folks were having trouble at the steam pools. You're an adventurer, right? Maybe you can do something about it.
string: 听说有些居民在蒸汽池那儿遇到麻烦了。你不是冒险者吗？或许你能帮上点忙。

original: Other then that, maybe try the records at the Tradehouse if you're looking to learn more about the history of the island.
string: 至于其他的，你可以去交易所翻翻那边的文献，说不定能了解到这座岛的一些历史。

original: Why is the inn called The Handsome Hermit?
string: 为什么这家旅店叫“俏隐士”？

original: My husband knows but he refuses to tell anyone about it. Good luck trying to find out.
string: 我的丈夫知道其中的缘由，但他拒绝告诉任何人。想弄清楚的话，祝你好运吧。

original: What do you do here?
I'm supposed to be the cleaner! But somebody has to step up and maintain order when Lurius is absent.
string: 我本应该是个清洁工！但卢里乌斯不在的时候，总得有人站出来维持秩序吧。

original: You'd struggle to gather at least half a wit among the miners. Hmpf!
string: 想在这些矿工里找到哪怕半点脑子都难。哼！

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
If it wasn't for the coin, I'd have taken the first ship back to Windhelm. That's the kind of place Wyrmstooth is.
string: 要不是为了赚钱，我早就坐头一班船回风舵城去了。龙牙岛就是这样的地方。

original: Is there anything you need help with?
string: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

original: Yes, in fact there is something you can help me with, if you care to hear me out.
string: 是的，如果你愿意听我说完，我确实有点事想请你帮忙。

original: A few moments ago an ignorant lout walked into the tradehouse and started pestering me, asking me all sorts of bothersome questions.
string: 刚才有个傻瓜走进了交易所然后开始纠缠我，问我一些超烦人的问题。

original: 'Tell me about Wyrmstooth', 'What do you do here', it's an unbearable burden on these tired old ears.
string: 比如“跟我讲讲龙牙岛吧”，“你在这里都做些什么”，这些话简直让我这双老耳朵不堪其扰。

original: So, I want you to do something about it; remove this individual from the tradehouse by what ever means necessary.
string: 所以，我希望你能帮我点忙，无论用什么手段都可以，把那蠢货给我弄出交易所可以吗。

original: Go on. Write it in your journal. Good! Well? What are you waiting for? I've given you a quest, now get to it!
string: 来吧。把它写在你的日记里。好极了！嗯？你还在等啥？我已经给了你任务，现在就去做啊！

original: I'll... be going.
Congratulations. You're halfway to becoming a true hero of the people.
string: 恭喜你。你终于有点人们嘴里所说的英雄的样子了。

original: What do you do here?
I keep Bolmar alive, just as well too with those spriggans about.
string: 我负责保住波玛的性命，考虑到那些木灵到处出没，这活儿还真挺重要的。

original: I also keep in touch with the East Empire Company and keep them up to date with our progress here.
string: 我还负责与东帝国公司保持联系，让他们随时了解我们在这里的进展。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
Well, from what we've seen so far, it's one hell of a place to dig for ore.
string: 嗯，就我们目前所见，这里真他妈是个挖矿的好地方。

original: What do you do here?
I make sure the men don't get out of line. Don't worry, I've got things covered.
string: 我负责维持这儿的治安，确保人们都遵纪守法。别担心，一切都在我的掌控之中。

original: I also report back to the East Empire Company on a regular basis, keep them appraised of the situation here.
string: 我还会定期向东帝国公司汇报，让他们了解这里的情况。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
I only just arrived. You're better off asking a local, if there are any.
string: 我是新来的。你最好还是问问这儿的当地人吧，如果有当地人的话。

original: Tell me about yourself.
I used to fight for the legion until an injury took me out of battle. Tried mercenary work for a time but the traveling was hell on my bad leg.
string: 我过去曾在军团当兵，直到受伤才被迫退出。之后我试着当过一段时间的雇佣兵，但长途跋涉对于我这伤腿来说是种折磨。

original: What kind of threats can we expect?
string: 我们将会面临什么样的威胁呢？

original: Imperial records kept here before the fort was abandoned suggest local banditry was commonplace and likely still is.
string: 堡垒被废弃前所保存的帝国文件显示，当地土匪猖獗，现在可能依然如此。

original: Witches too once occupied the fort for a number of years. It's possible they may return from time to time but we'll be ready.
string: 女巫们也曾占据过这个堡垒长达几年的时间，她们可能会时不时地回来，但我们会做好准备。

original: The fire trap at the gate is fully operational. It won't take much to dispatch intruders.
string: 大门那儿的火焰陷阱已经完全启动了。对付那些入侵者还是足够了的。

original: What do you do here?
I work the forge.
Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
I'm just the smith, not a historian.
string: 我就是个铁匠，不是历史学家。

original: What do you have for sale?
That which matters most.
What do you do here?
See the chef's hat on my head? It's not there for show.
string: 看到我头上的厨师帽了吗？它可不是摆设。

original: Fifteen years! Fifteen years I spent cooking for jarls and counts across Skyrim and Cyrodiil and look where I've ended up.
string: 15年啊！15年来我走遍天际和希罗帝尔，为各地的领主和伯爵们做饭，可看看我如今沦落成了什么样。

original: I might as well walk out there into the wilderness buck naked and let the cold take me to oblivion!
string: 我还不如光着身子走进荒野里去，让寒风把我送去湮灭算了。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
All I know is the people here don't appreciate fine cuisine. My skills are wasted on you lot!
string: 我所知道的就是这儿没人懂得欣赏精致的美食。我这手艺在这儿简直就是浪费！

original: What do you have for sale?
Food and drink, take a look.
What do you do here?
I clean up the mess, but only because the East Empire Company pays me to.
string: 负责给别人擦屁股，但也只是因为东帝国公司付了钱让我这么做。

original: Did you know, while you were gone, bandits walked in here? Bandits! I had to fight them off myself!
string: 你知道吗，在你不在的时候，有强盗闯了进来？强盗！我不得不单枪匹马击退他们！

original: You should've seen me. Pfeh, twenty long years serving alongside imperial legionnaires and this is where I end up.
string: 你应该亲眼看看我当时的样子。哼，我为帝国军团服役了二十多年，最后却落得如此下场。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
I'd leave if it wasn't for my sea sickness. I fear the voyage back to the main land would pain me more than than staying!
string: 要不是晕船的话我早就离开这个地方了。我就怕乘船回去的旅程会比留下来更让我痛苦！

original: What do you do here?
I tend the garden here. If you need any... herbs, you know who to ask.
string: 我在这里照料花园。如果你需要任何……草药，你知道该找谁。

original: Tell me about Wyrmstooth.
I suppose it meets expectations. Cold, unforgiving, and that's just its people. But there is a mystery to this island that is hard to pin down.
string: 我想它跟我预期的一样。寒冷，无情，而这正是岛上居民的本性。不过这岛上还有不少未解之谜。

original: My advice is to get out there and explore every nook and cranny this island has to offer. Who knows what you'll find.
string: 我的建议是走出去，探索这座岛屿的每一个角落。谁知道你会发现什么呢？

original: What do you have for sale?
I thought you'd never ask.
Why do they call you 'Sits-With-Beetles'?
string: 为什么大家称你为“与虫同坐”?

original: It was the name given to me when I was but a hatchling. It's only a coincidence that my current line of work involves working the soil.
string: 那是我还是个幼崽时就被赐予的名字。而我现在的工作恰好和泥土有关，只能说纯属巧合。

original: A little coin always greases the wheels...
string: 小小的金币总是能疏通关节……

original: You don't have enough gold to pay it off, and I'm not cutting any deals.
string: 你没足够的钱来还债，我也不会跟你达成交易。

original: I don't have to take this from the likes of you!
string: 我没必要听你这种人的。

original: Stop that. Keep your spells to yourself!
I suppose you're free to frolic with the wenches in the servant's quarters. But anywhere else, you must have an escort. Jarl's orders.
string: 领主有令，在侍者区域，你可以随意和那里的姑娘们嬉戏，但是在其他地方必须有人陪同。

original: What do you have for sale?
I bet I can forge you a better weapon than... whatever that is.
string: 我敢打赌我能打造一件比你现在手上那把……不知道啥玩意儿更好的武器。

original: Only the best weapons and armor.
string: 只有最好的武器和护甲。

original: Take a look.
You won't find a better deal elsewhere.
string: 你在别处找不到比这更划算的交易了。

original: I'm sure there's something that suits your needs.
string: 我敢肯定，总有一款适合你。

original: What can you tell me about Wyrmstooth?
Not much. The only place I've travelled to was to the inn for drinks with the crew.
string: 我也不怎么了解。我一般只会去这里的旅店，然后和我的船员们喝上几杯。

original: Seems like a cold, miserable place most of the year. They have trouble growing crops but on the bright side that keeps us in business.
string: 这地方全年都很冷，是个让人不舒服的地方。庄稼长势不好，不过好处是，这让我们有生意可做。

original: Tell me about yourself.
Ain't much to tell, really. I left Roscrea to join Safia's crew, anything to get out and see the world.
string: 其实也没什么好说的。我离开罗斯克拉，加入了萨非亚的团队——只要能离开家乡去看看外面的世界，做什么都行。

original: It's tough work but we make good gold. Demand's high for our services right now.
string: 这活儿虽然辛苦，但收入还不错。眼下大家对我们的需求正旺。

original: I'd like to travel back to Skyrim.
Very well. I'll let the captain know and we'll be on our way.
string: 好的。我会通知船长，马上就出发。

original: Ship's ready to set sail. We're ready whenever you are.
string: 船已准备就绪，随时可以起航。

original: I'd like to travel back to Wyrmstooth.
Very well. I'll let the captain know and we'll be on our way.
string: 好的。我会通知船长，马上就出发。

original: Ship's ready to set sail. We're ready whenever you are.
string: 船已准备就绪，随时可以起航。

original: You're... a mudcrab!
And you're... you! What ever you may be. It's a bit hard for me to tell with these eyes.
string: 而你……是你！我也不知道你是啥，用我这双眼睛太难辨认站在我前面的是啥了。

original: But don't let my appearance fool you. I assure you my wares are only the highest quality.
string: 不过别被我这外表给欺骗了。我保证我卖的东西都是最高品质的。

original: How did this happen to you?
Well... let's just call it an occupational hazard when dealing with Telvanni sorcerers.
string: 好吧……就让我们称之为职业风险吧，尤其是当你在跟泰瓦尼的法师打交道的时候。

original: One bad deal and *pow*, suddenly I'm a mudcrab. It's not my fault he couldn't recognize a bargain when he saw one.
string: 一笔糟糕的交易，然后“砰”的一声，我就变成一只泥沼蟹了。这可怪不得我，要怪就怪那个家伙有眼无珠，看不出什么是真正的划算买卖。

original: But worry not, I'm not letting my... disability prevent me from doing what I do best: selling only the best of wares at low low prices!
string: 但别担心，我绝不会让我的……这点“残疾”妨碍我做最擅长的事：以超低价格出售最好的商品！

original: But your store is in the middle of nowhere.
string: 但你的商店开在荒郊野外啊。

original: Well, I tried to set up a stall in Solitude but my... physique tends to scare away prospective buyers.
string: 我其实试过在独孤城设个摊位，但我的……外形往往会吓跑潜在顾客。

original: Not to mention some folk have a penchant for crab meat. Cannibals they are.
string: 更别提某些对蟹肉有特别嗜好的当地人了。他们会把我给吃了的。

original: So long as my contract with the East Empire Company doesn't expire I'll be out here selling my wares.
string: 只要我和东帝国公司的合同还没到期，我就会一直在这儿做生意。

original: Is there anything I can do for you?
For me? No, no. You know the saying; when life gives you lemons...
string: 为我？不，不用，你知道那句老话的：人生不如意十之八九，但否极泰来嘛……

original: It might even work in my favor... once word starts to spread about the mudcrab merchant and his fantastic bargains, that is.
string: 一旦人们听说有个泥沼蟹商人卖的都是物超所值的好东西，说不定还能对我有利呢。

original: Where do your wares come from?
string: 你这些货物都是从哪儿来的？

original: I import the majority of my stock from the mainland but adventurers like yourself often stop by to trade rare items for gold.
string: 大部分都是从大陆进口的，不过像你这样的冒险者也经常会路过这里，用一些稀有物品来换点金币。

original: Aren't you afraid of the marauders?
I offer appraisal services for the cut-throats and brigands that operate on this island, ensure they don't get the bad end of a deal.
string: 我会为岛上的那些亡命徒提供鉴定服务，确保他们在交易中不会吃亏。

original: I also use my channels to move rare items for them. There are collectors in Tamriel that would pay a royal sum for the rubbish excavated here.
string: 我也会利用我的特殊渠道帮他们处理一些稀有物品。泰姆瑞尔那儿有些收藏家们会花大价钱购买从这儿挖出来的那些垃圾。

original: So you're in league with the marauders?
string: 那么说来你和掠夺者们是一伙的？

original: Not at all. My allegiances lay purely with the customer. I am but a simple merchant at heart, nothing more.
string: 绝无此事。我的忠诚只属于我的顾客。我不过是个本本分分的商人罢了，仅此而已。

original: What do you have for sale?
I thought you'd never ask.
WTDialogueIdleCombatTrespassLines
Oh great, an uninvited guest. Leave, stranger, before I call the guards.
string: 哦好极了，来了位不速之客。马上离开这里，不然我要叫卫兵了。

original: You're still here, did I not tell you to leave already?
string: 你还在这儿啊，我不是叫你离开了吗？

original: Guards! We've got a trespasser!
string: 卫兵！我们这儿有个非法侵入者！

original: Sorry, stranger. This is my home, not yours. Get out.
string: 抱歉，陌生人，这是我的家，不是你的。滚出去。

original: I'm pretty sure I just told you to get out of my home. Do I need to call the guards?
string: 我已经警告过你立刻从我家滚出去了。难道说我得叫卫兵吗？

original: Guards! GUARDS! Trespasser! Arrest this fool!
string: 卫兵！卫兵！有闯入者！把这蠢货抓起来！

original: Sorry, friend. Visiting hours are over. I'm going to have to ask you to leave so we can get a bit of shut-eye.
string: 抱歉啊朋友。参观时间差不多结束了。我们要睡觉了，请你离开我家吧。

original: You're... still here. This is awkward; I really don't want to have to get the guards involved...
string: 你居然……还在这儿。真让人吃惊，我真的不想叫卫兵来……

original: Sorry, friend, but you leave me no choice. Guards! Show this trespasser the door!
string: 抱歉啊朋友，但你让我别无选择。卫兵！把这个入侵者给扔出去！

original: This isn't an inn, traveler. I'm going to have to ask you to leave.
string: 旅行者，这里可不是旅店。请你离开。

original: I'm warning you, traveler. I'll call the guards if I have to.
string: 我警告你，旅行者。必要的话我会叫卫兵的。

original: Guards! Remove this stranger from our home!
string: 卫兵！把这个陌生人从我家赶出去！

original: It's not wise to break into a blacksmith's home. So leave.
string: 擅闯铁匠的住所可不是明智之举。所以赶紧滚。

original: The door's over there. Use it already.
Alright, you've asked for it. Guards! There's a skull over here that needs cracking!
string: 好吧，你逼我的。卫兵！这儿有个欠打的入侵者！

original: By the Gods, can't I get a little privacy here? Get out!
string: 天哪，我就不能有一点隐私吗？快出去！

original: I'm warning you, get out now before I call the guards!
string: 我警告你，现在就离开，否则我就叫卫兵了！

original: That's it. Guards! Trespasser!
Sorry, friend. You're going to have to leave.
string: 抱歉啊朋友。你得离开这儿了。

original: I'd hate to cause any trouble, but you really are overstaying your welcome.
string: 我不想惹麻烦，但你在这儿不受欢迎。

original: Sorry, friend, but you've brought this on yourself. Guards! Guards!
string: 抱歉啊朋友，但你这是自作自受。卫兵！卫兵！

original: Get out. Now!
Guards! We've got a trespasser!
string: 卫兵！我们这儿有个非法侵入者！

original: I said guards! By the Gods, where are you useless fools?
string: 我说——卫兵！天呐，你们这群废物究竟哪儿去了？！

original: You! Get out.
*sigh* Last warning, fool. Get out before I ram this pickaxe through your skull.
string: *叹气* 最后警告你一次，笨蛋。在我用鹤嘴锄敲烂你的脑袋之前赶紧滚出去。

original: Right. Now you're gonna get it. Guards! Trespasser!
string: 好吧。这是你自找的。卫兵！有入侵者！

original: I know I'm irresistible, but it's getting late and I must ask you to leave.
string: 我知道我很迷人，但现在太晚了，我得请你离开了。

original: Maybe you didn't hear me the first time, but I'm going to have to call the guards if you don't remove yourself from my humble abode.
string: 或许我说第一遍的时候你没有听清楚，那我重复一遍，你要是再不肯走我就喊卫兵来把你扔出我家了。

original: Very well. Guards! My beautiful face is in danger! Do something immediately!
string: 好吧。卫兵！我这张绝世容颜正面临险境！请立刻采取行动！

original: Why on Nirn would you want to linger here? For your own sake be on your way.
string: 奈恩这么大，你为什么偏偏要在这种地方逗留？为了你好，请赶紧离开。

original: Seriously. Leave.
Guards! Help! Burglar!
How did you get in here? You need to leave.
string: 你怎么进来的？你必须离开。

original: Mama, didn't we lock the door already?
string: 妈妈，我们不是锁了门吗？

original: If you don't leave, my papa is going to throw you out!
string: 如果你不走，我爸爸会把你扔出去的！

original: Oh boy, you're going to be in a lot of trouble if you don't get out of here right now!
string: 天啊，如果你不马上离开这里，你会有很多麻烦的！

original: Oh, it's you. I should've guessed as much.
string: 噢，是你啊。我早该猜到的。

original: You were expecting me?
Well, it's not like your presence on this island has gone unnoticed.
string: 毕竟，你在这个岛上可不是什么默默无闻的存在。

original: Nor would I expect anyone else to be stupid enough to go to such great lengths to explore this long lost dwemer ruin.
string: 我也不认为还有别人会蠢到花费如此大劲去探索这座失落已久的矮人遗迹。

original: Yes, your reputation does indeed precede you.
string: 是的，你的名声早已传开。

original: And yet I would ask you a service, now that you're here.
string: 不过既然你已经来了，我想请你帮个忙。

original: Not Interested.
Well, isn't that a pity. Here I was willing to offer you an opportunity for more adventure. That is what you seek, right?
string: 唉，真可惜。我还打算给你一个机会，让你体验更多的冒险呢。那不正是你所追求的吗？

original: Come and talk to me again should you change your mind.
string: 如果你改变主意了，再来和我谈。

original: What are you and why are you here?
string: 你是什么生物，你为什么会在这里？

original: What am I? Hmm. I suppose it has been a long time since I was a human, like you, but prettier. So much prettier.
string: 我是什么？嗯……我已经不再像你一样是个凡人很久了，虽然我那时要比现在的你好看得多，好看得多。

original: I was once a young witch of the Reach under the tutelage of the hags. They shared their knowledge with me and offered me power.
string: 我曾经是瑞驰的的一名年轻女巫，师从一群乌鸦鬼婆。她们传授了我知识，赐予了我力量。

original: In exchange for my humanity, that is. Such as it has always been, the more powerful you become the less you resemble who you were.
string: 但需要用我的人性作为交换。就像一直以来那样，你变得越强，你就越不像原来的自己。

original: Your power also corrupts you; with each dragon soul you devour you become less human. We are more alike than it seems.
string: 你的力量也会一直腐蚀你；每当你吞噬一条龙魂，你就越不像人类。我们其实很相似。

original: I came to this island seeking solitude. Yes, the powerful have a habit of being drawn to each other. Like you and I now.
string: 我来这个岛是为了寻求独处。是的，强者总是会相互吸引。就像现在的你我一样。

original: What do you need?
It is but a simple thing, really. Not something that would trouble the heart of a grizzled adventurer such as yourself.
string: 其实很简单。对像你这样身经百战的冒险者来说，根本不算什么难事。

original: All I need is...
...a moment of your passionate love.
Wait... what?
Oh come on! Do an old girl a favor and ruffle a few of these feathers for awhile.
string: 噢，拜托！帮老姑娘一个忙，让她高兴高兴高兴吧。

original: I've got some shiny trinkets for you if you make it a good one!
string: 如果你做得好，我还会送你一些闪闪发光的小玩意！

original: I can see it in your eyes. You want a little piece of this drumstick, don't you?
string: 我从你的眼神里看出来了——你也想尝尝这鸡腿的滋味，不是吗？

original: No. Just... no.
What, am I more woman than you can handle? And here I thought all you adventurers wanted was a little adventure.
string: 怎么，我的女人味太浓，你驾驭不了？我还以为你们这些冒险者想要的就是一点点冒险呢。

original: If you change your mind and truly want to help someone in need, you know where to find me. Right here. All alone...
string: 如果你改变了主意，真心想帮助一个需要帮助的人，你知道去哪儿找我。我就在这儿，孤独一人……

original: I can't, I'm married...
Then it'll be our little secret, won't it?
string: 那我们一起保守这个小秘密就好了吧？

original: Changed your mind, have you? Ready to give a lonely old bird a time she'll never forget?
string: 你改变主意了吗？准备好让这只孤单的老鸟享受一次她永生难忘的时光了吗？

original: Sure. I've had worse...
Oh, on the contrary, you'll never have better. You have no idea how many techniques I've been working on over the centuries.
string: 哦，恰恰相反，你再也不会有比这更好的了。你不知道我几个世纪以来研究了多少技术。

original: Now, come over here. Make yourself comfortable and let me share Dibella's blessing.
string: 来吧，过来这边。放松点，让我为你献上迪贝拉的祝福。

original: Well, I guess that'll have to do for now. It wasn't bad, but it wasn't exactly good either.
string: 嗯，好吧，这次就这样吧。说不上特别好，但也还行。

original: No matter, as promised, a reward for your efforts.
string: 没关系，如我所承诺的，我会奖励你的努力。

original: Let's never speak of this again.
Oh you sure know how to sweet talk a lady.
string: 噢，你可真是懂得讨女士欢心。

original: You be a good little adventurer now, and don't forget to work on your techniques!
string: 现在去做个听话的小冒险家吧，记得多练练你的技巧！

original: You've got the claw, now go! We'll hold them off.
string: 你拿到龙爪了，现在继续前进！我们会挡住他们的。

original: Wait here.
Don't take too long.
Follow me.
Certainly, lead on.
Wait here.
If you say so.
Follow me.
Lead on.
Wait here.
And what, I'm supposed to just stand here? Fine, have it your way. But don't blame me if you find a stack of charred corpses when you return.
string: 怎么着，难道我就得在这干站着？好吧，随你便。不过你回来时要是看到一堆焦黑的尸体可别怪我。

original: I get bored very easily and I'm not very good at hiding things.
string: 我这人很容易无聊，而且也藏不住东西。

original: Follow me.
It's about time.
Wait here.
If I must, but try to lure some enemies this way.
string: 如果非得等的话，至少引几个敌人过来让我打发下时间吧。

original: Follow me.
Well, it's about time.
What can you tell me about Wyrmstooth?
Mama tells me there are some bad people on the island, so we lock our doors at night in case they come by.
string: 妈妈告诉我这个岛上有坏人，所以我们晚上会锁门，以防他们进来。

original: The town guards were all burned by that dragon, so we need to be really careful now.
string: 镇里的卫兵都被那条龙烧伤了，所以我们现在必须非常小心。

original: But hopefully the guards catch them.
string: 但愿那些卫兵能抓住他们。

original: Tell me about Stonehollow.
Well if you need to trade, speak with papa. He's the blacksmith. I bet he can forge you a really good weapon!
string: 好吧，如果你想交易的话，就跟爸爸说。他是个铁匠。我打赌他能给你锻造一件好武器！

original: The khajiit have general goods and supplies, so go and speak to them too!
string: 那些卡吉特人会卖日常用品和补给，所以你也可以去和他们谈谈！

original: We used to have an inn, but it was burned down by that dragon.
string: 我们这里以前有家旅店，但被恶龙烧毁了。

original: If you need food you should go to the inn. They call it The Hermit, but I don't know why.
string: 如果你需要食物的话，就该去旅馆。他们叫它“俏隐士”，但我不清楚为什么。

original: There's a really mean lady that works at the tradehouse, so I stay away. I think she's still upset that Lurius left the town for so long.
string: 交易所里有个很刻薄的女士，所以我会离她远点。我觉得她还在为卢里乌斯离开镇子这么久而生气。

original: Did you see where the dragon went?
It headed east, over the mountains.
Mama said there's an old Nordic barrow on the eastern side of the island. Maybe it went there?
string: 妈妈说在岛的东侧有一个古老的诺德墓穴。也许它去了那里？
